We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent $SO(6)$ monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing $Z_{2}$ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a $U(1)$ Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
summary: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体中出现的 $SO(6)$ 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。最后，随着系统规模的增长，具有 Gutzwiller 投影平均场状态的优化 NQS 的保真度越来越有利于狄拉克状态，而不是竞争的 $Z_{2}$ 候选状态。总之，这些互补的结果为 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中的 $U(1)$ 狄拉克自旋液体基态提供了证据。

title: Universality in Anomalous Diffusion: Power Laws and Faster-Decaying Tails
abstract: Strong anomalous diffusion is often characterized by a piecewise-linear spectrum of the moments of displacement. The spectrum is characterized by the slopes $\theta$ and $\zeta$ for small and large moments, respectively, and by the crossover moment $q_c$ at which the slope changes. The exponents $\theta$ and $\zeta$ characterize the asymptotic scaling of the bulk and of the tails of the probability distribution function of displacements, respectively. Here, we adopt asymptotic theory to match the behaviors at intermediate scales. The resulting constraint explains how distributions with algebraic tails imply strong anomalous diffusion, and it relates $q_c$ to the corresponding power law. Our theory provides universal hyper-scaling relations between the exponents characterizing strong anomalous diffusion, and it yields explicit expressions for the leading-order corrections to the asymptotic power-law behavior of the moments of displacement. We also characterize finite-time corrections and propose a robust distribution-based method to estimate $\theta$, $\zeta$, and $q_c$. The findings are supported by numerical and analytical results for three paradigmatic models exhibiting strong anomalous diffusion. Finally, we show that power-law tails are not only sufficient but also necessary for this scenario: with a Gaussian, or generally fast-decaying, bulk and exponentially rare ballistic excursions, the spectrum of moments is single-linear, and the crossover to the apparent second branch drifts with the observation time. When the bulk is fast decaying and the tail is a power law, strong anomalous diffusion is still present, but the hyper-scaling relations among the exponents are violated.
summary:
强反常扩散通常以位移矩的分段线性谱为特征。该频谱的特征是分别针对小力矩和大力矩的斜率 $\theta$ 和 $\zeta$，以及斜率变化时的交叉力矩 $q_c$。指数 $\theta$ 和 $\zeta$ 分别表征位移概率分布函数的体部和尾部的渐近缩放。在这里，我们采用渐近理论来匹配中间尺度的行为。由此产生的约束解释了具有代数尾部的分布如何意味着强反常扩散，并将 $q_c$ 与相应的幂律联系起来。我们的理论提供了表征强反常扩散的指数之间的普遍超尺度关系，并且它产生了位移矩渐近幂律行为的前导校正的显式表达式。我们还描述了有限时间修正的特征，并提出了一种基于稳健分布的方法来估计 $\theta$、$\zeta$ 和 $q_c$。

这些发现得到了三个表现出强烈异常扩散的范式模型的数值和分析结果的支持。最后，我们表明，幂律尾部对于这种情况不仅是充分的，而且是必要的：对于高斯或通常快速衰减、大量和指数罕见的弹道偏移，矩谱是单线性的，并且到明显第二分支的交叉随着观察时间而漂移。当体积快速衰减且尾部服从幂律时，仍然存在强烈的反常扩散，但指数之间的超标度关系被违反。

title: Minimal model of a Plateau-Rayleigh instability of a solid binary alloy nanowire: impacts of surface segregation
abstract: Minimal model and its linear stability analysis (LSA) for Plateau-Rayleigh (PR) instability of an intermixed, solid binary alloy nanowire is presented. Model accounts only for the surface diffusions of the alloy components without anisotropies of a surface energies, and for a classical thermodynamic surface segregation. Model allows to assess a deviation of a longwave instability cutoff wavelength $\lambda_c$ from the classical value $2\pi r_0$ (a wire circumference) as a function of a surface composition deviation from its equilibrium value, a wire radius, and a bulk concentration of a minority component. Results of LSA are presented for AuNi, PtNi, and CoNi nanowires, where an important distinction is that a surface segregation curve for CoNi is qualitatively different from the one for AuNi and PtNi. For each nanowire there is a sizable region of a parameter space where $\lambda_c<2\pi r_0$ and correspondingly, a fastest growing perturbation wavelength $\lambda_{max}$ is also less than a wire circumference. This is in stark contrast to PR instability of a single-component nanowire transporting mass by surface diffusion - in this case $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{max}$ are larger than a wire circumference. Strong surface segregation is primarily responsible for unusually small $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{max}$. Results suggest that a large number of small and closely spaced nanoparticles may emerge upon disintegration via annealing of a binary alloy nanowire.
summary:
提出了混合固体二元合金纳米线的高原瑞利 (PR) 不稳定性的最小模型及其线性稳定性分析 (LSA)。模型仅考虑合金成分的表面扩散，不考虑表面能的各向异性，以及经典的热力学表面偏析。模型允许评估长波不稳定性截止波长 $\lambda_c$ 与经典值 $2\pi r_0$ （线周长）的偏差，作为表面成分与其平衡值的偏差、线半径和少数成分的体积浓度的函数。给出了 AuNi、PtNi 和 CoNi 纳米线的 LSA 结果，其中一个重要的区别是 CoNi 的表面偏析曲线与 AuNi 和 PtNi 的表面偏析曲线有本质上的不同。对于每根纳米线，参数空间都有一个相当大的区域，其中 $\lambda_c<2\pi r_0$ ，相应地，增长最快的扰动波长 $\lambda_{max}$ 也小于线周长。

这与通过表面扩散传输质量的单组分纳米线的 PR 不稳定性形成鲜明对比 - 在这种情况下 $\lambda_c$ 和 $\lambda_{max}$ 大于线周长。强烈的表面偏析是造成 $\lambda_c$ 和 $\lambda_{max}$ 异常小的主要原因。结果表明，通过二元合金纳米线的退火分解时，可能会出现大量小而紧密排列的纳米颗粒。

title: Crossover duality for the quantum long-range Ising chain: perturbation theory around the short-range endpoint and a DMRG test
abstract: We propose a weakly coupled description of the long-range transverse-field Ising chain near its short-range crossover at $s_*=7/4$, where the couplings decay as $r^{-1-s}$. The Ising conformal field theory is coupled to an instantaneous Gaussian field through $\sigma\chi$, extending the classical long-range Ising duality to quantum chains. The equal-time interaction generates a stress-tensor deformation that causes the velocity to run and renormalizes the dynamical critical exponent $z$. Conformal perturbation theory gives $z=1-0.720\,\delta+O(\delta^2)$, $1/\nu=(1+z)/2+O(\delta^2)$, and $\omega=\delta+O(\delta^2)$, with $\delta=s_*-s$. DMRG calculations on periodic chains of up to $128$ sites provide a consistency test using theoretical inputs for $1/\nu$ and $\omega$. After accounting for slow finite-size corrections, static and dynamical estimates of $z$ agree, supporting the crossover expansion at $s=1.5$ and a two-sided Padé interpolation at $s=1$, $1.25$, and $1.5$.
summary: 我们提出了对 $s_*=7/4$ 处短程交叉点附近的长程横向场伊辛链的弱耦合描述，其中耦合衰减为 $r^{-1-s}$。伊辛共形场论通过 $\sigma\chi$ 耦合到瞬时高斯场，将经典的长程伊辛对偶性扩展到量子链。等时相互作用产生应力张量变形，导致速度运行并重新规范化动态临界指数 $z$。共形微扰理论给出 $z=1-0.720\,\delta+O(\delta^2)$、$1/\nu=(1+z)/2+O(\delta^2)$ 和 $\omega=\delta+O(\delta^2)$，其中 $\delta=s_*-s$。对最多 $128$ 站点的周期链进行 DMRG 计算，使用 $1/\nu$ 和 $\omega$ 的理论输入提供一致性测试。考虑到缓慢的有限大小修正后，$z$ 的静态和动态估计一致，支持 $s=1.5$ 处的交叉扩展以及 $s=1$、$1.25$ 和 $1.5$ 处的两侧 Padé 插值。

title: How symmetry and complexity shape three-dimensional programmable self-assembly
abstract: Self-assembly enables complex structures to emerge from simple building blocks through local interaction rules. Are some structures intrinsically easier to design, that is, do they admit more sets of assembly rules than others? And, can this be predicted from their geometry? We address these questions using a three-dimensional polycube model with programmable face-to-face binding, defining a structure's assembly rule probability as the chance that a randomly chosen rule set produces it. For polycubes, this probability decreases exponentially with assembly complexity, the minimum information required to specify a structure's assembly rules. Intuitively, this follows because structures with low assembly complexity are generated not only by minimal rule sets but also by numerous more elaborate ones, and so arise disproportionately often. Symmetry can reduce assembly complexity by allowing the same building blocks and local interactions to be reused across different parts of a structure. Indeed, we find that the highest probability structures come from a tiny subset of highly symmetric structures. However, symmetry alone does not determine assembly complexity. Structures with the same symmetry can differ substantially in the amount of assembly information they require, depending on how effectively their global symmetry can be exploited by local growth rules. Overall, our results link information, symmetry, and assembly rule probability and suggest that identifying which geometric features permit rule reuse is central to designing minimal programmable self-assembling systems.
summary:
自组装使得复杂的结构能够通过局部相互作用规则从简单的构建块中出现。某些结构本质上是否更容易设计，也就是说，它们是否比其他结构允许更多的装配规则集？而且，这可以从它们的几何形状中预测出来吗？我们使用具有可编程面对面绑定的三维多立方体模型来解决这些问题，将结构的组装规则概率定义为随机选择的规则集产生它的机会。对于多边形立方体，这种概率随着装配复杂性（指定结构的装配规则所需的最少信息）呈指数下降。直观上，这是因为低组装复杂性的结构不仅是由最小的规则集生成的，而且是由许多更复杂的规则集生成的，因此出现的频率不成比例。对称性可以通过允许在结构的不同部分重复使用相同的构建块和局部交互来降低装配复杂性。事实上，我们发现概率最高的结构来自高度对称结构的微小子集。然而，对称性本身并不能决定装配的复杂性。

具有相同对称性的结构在所需的组装信息量方面可能存在很大差异，具体取决于局部增长规则如何有效地利用其全局对称性。总的来说，我们的结果将信息、对称性和组装规则概率联系起来，并表明识别哪些几何特征允许规则重用是设计最小可编程自组装系统的核心。

title: Exact Rokhsar-Kivelson points hosting first-order phase transitions in $S=1$ compass models
abstract: We study $S=1$ compass models on the square and kagome lattices with bond-dependent bilinear and biquadratic interactions parametrized by an angle $\theta$. For compatible geometries, we determine the exact ground-state manifolds throughout the interval $\pi/4\leq\theta\leq3\pi/4$. At each endpoint, a product of on-site unitaries maps the Hamiltonian to the Laplacian of a configuration graph $\mathcal{G}$ in the $S=1$ Cartesian basis. These endpoints are exact Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) points, with one ground state per dynamically connected component of $\mathcal{G}$. Each such state is an equal-amplitude superposition in the transformed basis and acquires configuration-dependent phases upon transforming back to the original basis. Both models possess $m=O(L)$ independent and mutually commuting conserved $\mathbb{Z}_2$ line charges, where $L$ is the linear system size, forcing a ground-state degeneracy of at least $2^m$ at the RK endpoints. Throughout the interior region, $\pi/4<\theta<3\pi/4$, the ground-state manifold on each lattice is instead spanned by two product states, both annihilated by the Hamiltonian. On both lattices, each RK endpoint also hosts a first-order transition into this intervening interior phase spanned by the two product states with long-range order.
summary:
我们研究了方形和 kagome 晶格上的 $S=1$ 罗盘模型，其具有由角度 $\theta$ 参数化的键相关双线性和双二次相互作用。对于兼容的几何形状，我们确定整个区间 $\pi/4\leq\theta\leq3\pi/4$ 的精确基态流形。在每个端点，现场幺正的乘积将哈密顿量映射到配置图 $\mathcal{G}$ 在 $S=1$ 笛卡尔基础上的拉普拉斯算子。这些端点是精确的 Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) 点，$\mathcal{G}$ 的每个动态连接组件都有一个基态。每个这样的状态都是变换后的基础中的等幅叠加，并且在变换回原始基础时获得配置相关的相位。两个模型都具有 $m=O(L)$ 独立且相互交换的守恒 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 线电荷，其中 $L$ 是线性系统大小，迫使 RK 端点处的基态简并度至少为 $2^m$。在整个内部区域，$\pi/4<\theta<3\pi/4$，每个晶格上的基态流形都由两个乘积态跨越，这两个乘积态都被哈密顿量消灭。

在这两个晶格上，每个 RK 端点还承载一个一阶过渡到由两个具有长程顺序的乘积状态跨越的中间内部阶段。

title: Higher-order interactions renormalize the thermodynamic signature of neural population codes
abstract: Maximum-entropy models of neural recordings can be treated as Boltzmann distributions at a fictitious temperature $T$, with the fitted model at $T=1$. Their specific-heat peak grows with population size and approaches that temperature, which has been read as a sign of criticality. The case rests on pairwise models, yet retinal codes require higher-order interactions. The thermodynamics of a model with such interactions fitted cell by cell has not been computed. Here I compute it exactly for pairwise and third-order models of the same populations of up to $20$ retinal ganglion cells, in salamander and marmoset. The triplet terms, required by the held-out likelihood, shift the peak by more than the finite-sample bias, with opposite sign in the two retinas. The peak is lower and grows more slowly in salamander, higher and grows faster in marmoset, and lies closer to $T=1$ in both. An exact decomposition traces most of the shift to the energy variance across population spike counts. A constraint on the spike-count distribution alone reproduces all of it in salamander and over half in marmoset. A second recording of each species, re-binning, and a common-input surrogate show that the sign is set by the spike-count structure of a recording at its temporal resolution, not by species. The thermodynamic signature of a neural code is therefore set not by the data alone but by the interaction order of the model used to read it.
summary:
神经记录的最大熵模型可以被视为虚拟温度 $T$ 下的玻尔兹曼分布，拟合模型为 $T=1$。它们的比热峰值随着种群数量的增加而增加，并接近该温度，这被视为临界的标志。该案例依赖于成对模型，但视网膜编码需要更高阶的交互。具有逐个细胞拟合的这种相互作用的模型的热力学尚未被计算。在这里，我对蝾螈和狨猴的相同群体视网膜神经节细胞的成对和三阶模型进行了精确计算，该群体的视网膜神经节细胞高达 20 美元。保留似然所需的三元组项将峰值移动超过有限样本偏差，在两个视网膜中具有相反的符号。蝾螈的峰值较低且生长较慢，狨猴的峰值较高且生长较快，并且两者都更接近 $T=1$。精确的分解追踪了总体尖峰计数中能量方差的大部分转变。仅对尖峰计数分布的限制就可以在蝾螈中再现全部，在狨猴中再现一半以上。

每个物种的第二次记录、重新分箱和公共输入代理表明，该符号是由记录在其时间分辨率下的尖峰计数结构设置的，而不是由物种设置的。因此，神经代码的热力学特征不是单独由数据决定的，而是由用于读取数据的模型的交互顺序决定的。

title: Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
abstract: Pauling's electrostatic valence rule assigns to each bond of a cation of charge $z$ with $n$ anion neighbors the strength $z/n$. Bond-valence theory replaces the equal split of valence among bonds by $s=\exp[(R_0-d)/B]$ in the bond length $d$ and takes the sum rule, that the valences at each atom add to its formal charge, as its first axiom. Here the bond valence is defined in the electron density. Atomic basins of a first-principles density are bounded by faces, one per bond critical point, and the electric flux of that density through a face is a charge associated with the bond. The fluxes leaving a cation sum to its basin charge by Gauss's law, so on this surface the sum rule is a theorem. Across 3680 oxides, halides, chalcogenides and pnictides the flux follows the bond-valence law site by site, with a median deviation of ten percent. The softness $B$ varies nearly an order of magnitude from stiff sulfides to softer arsenides. In all cases it is set by the electrostatic flux at atomic basin faces. $R_0$ then follows from the bond lengths and their differences. Anion valences equal those of bonded cations to within 5\% for most of the oxide, fluoride, sulfide and nitride sites. Transferability of $(R_0,B)$ between compounds fails in 96 of 106 families, suggesting that the softness is a local site property defined by the basin charge rather than a transferable constant of a given cation--anion pair. Eliminating $B$ by the sum rule gives $s=(z/n)^{(R_0-d)/(R_0-d_B)}$, Pauling's strength raised to a distance exponent at the softness-weighted mean bond length $d_B$. Thus, bond-valence theory is Pauling's rule with a distance exponent, and the electron density supplies the surface on which the two are equivalent.
summary:
鲍林的静电价规则指定电荷 $z$ 的阳离子与 $n$ 阴离子的每个键的强度 $z/n$ 相邻。键价理论用键长 $d$ 中的 $s=\exp[(R_0-d)/B]$ 取代了键之间价数的均分，并采用总和规则，即每个原子的价数添加到其形式电荷上，作为其第一个公理。这里键价是用电子密度定义的。第一原理密度的原子盆由面界定，每个键临界点一个，并且该密度通过面的电通量是与键相关的电荷。离开阳离子的通量按照高斯定律求和至其盆地电荷，因此在该表面上求和规则是一个定理。在 3680 种氧化物、卤化物、硫族化物和磷族化物中，助熔剂逐位遵循键价定律，中值偏差为 10%。从坚硬的硫化物到较软的砷化物，软度$B$变化了近一个数量级。在所有情况下，它都是由原子盆表面的静电通量决定的。 $R_0$ 然后根据键长及其差异得出。对于大多数氧化物、氟化物、硫化物和氮化物位点，阴离子价数等于键合阳离子的价数在 5% 以内。

106 个族中的 96 个化合物之间 $(R_0,B)$ 的可转移性失败，这表明柔软度是由盆地电荷定义的局部位点特性，而不是给定阳离子-阴离子对的可转移常数。通过总和规则消除 $B$ 得到 $s=(z/n)^{(R_0-d)/(R_0-d_B)}$，鲍林强度提升到软度加权平均键长 $d_B$ 处的距离指数。因此，键价理论是具有距离指数的鲍林规则，并且电子密度提供了两者等效的表面。

title: Linear Response in the $\mathcal{PT}$-Broken Phase: Conductivity of Fermions with Complex Conjugate Masses
abstract: We examine the linear response of the $\PT$-broken phase of a BRST invariant model whose fermion masses form the complex conjugate pair $m_{\pm}=N\pm iav$. It splits into two channels, kept apart by an exact $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$, and one Euclidean correlator decides both. In the diagonal channel it oscillates in Euclidean time, so that channel admits no positive-norm realization: we exhibit a test function of negative norm and close every repair, the choice of boundary value among them. In the mixed channel the same correlator is completely monotone, which proves the spectral density positive; there we obtain the vacuum conductivity in closed form, with a real threshold at $\omega=2N$, and positivity survives at finite temperature below a bound whose onset we give exactly. The longitudinal density of that channel is negative by the square of the mass splitting; an antisymmetric derivative removes it, and the resulting field-strength composite has a positive one-particle space and a causal commutator --- at the level of the two-point function only, since a four-point reflection form on the original composite comes out negative. The positive realization is therefore not a sector of the fermion model.
summary:
我们检查 BRST 不变模型的 $\PT$ 破相的线性响应，该模型的费米子质量形成复共轭对 $m_{\pm}=N\pm iav$。它分成两个通道，由精确的 $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ 分隔开，并且一个欧几里德相关器决定这两个通道。在对角通道中，它以欧几里得时间振荡，因此该通道不允许正范数实现：我们展示负范数的测试函数并关闭每个修复，其中边界值的选择。在混合通道中，同一相关器是完全单调的，这证明谱密度为正；在那里，我们获得了封闭形式的真空电导率，其真实阈值为$\omega=2N$，并且在低于我们精确给出的边界的有限温度下，正性仍然存在。该通道的纵向密度为负值，乘以质量分裂的平方；反对称导数将其删除，并且所得的场强复合材料具有正的单粒子空间和因果换向器——仅在两点函数的水平上，因为原始复合材料上的四点反射形式结果为负。

因此，正实现不是费米子模型的一部分。

title: Meet biform singletons in your area! Topological actions for edge modes
abstract: We present topological field theories propagating biform singleton fields as edge modes. In even spacetime dimensions $D=2p$, these are irreducible representations of the conformal algebra $\mathfrak{so}(2,2p)$ with two-column Young diagrams of height $p$. Their duality properties depend on the parity of $p$: They propagate chiral degrees of freedom for odd $p$, and exhibit electric--magnetic duality for even $p$. We are able to construct the topological actions by realising the hidden conformal symmetry inherent to singletons geometrically in terms of an auxiliary bulk $\text{AdS}_{2p+1}$ geometry. Using these as a starting point, we are able to apply a recently established covariant boundary reduction procedure to yield novel action formulations with manifest Lorentz covariance. We also show how, breaking manifest Lorentz covariance, we recover known formulations of biform singletons.
summary: 我们提出了以边缘模式传播双形单例场的拓扑场论。在偶数时空维度 $D=2p$ 中，这些是共形代数 $\mathfrak{so}(2,2p)$ 的不可约表示，具有高度 $p$ 的两列杨氏图。它们的对偶性取决于 $p$ 的宇称性：它们对于奇数 $p$ 传播手性自由度，对于偶数 $p$ 表现出电磁二象性。我们能够通过辅助体 $\text{AdS}_{2p+1}$ 几何体实现单例几何固有的隐藏共形对称性来构造拓扑动作。以这些为起点，我们能够应用最近建立的协变边界缩减程序来产生具有明显洛伦兹协方差的新颖作用公式。我们还展示了如何打破明显的洛伦兹协方差，恢复已知的双形单例公式。

title: Worldsheet functional RG and the $α'$-tower
abstract: We apply the functional renormalization group to the worldsheet theory of the bosonic string. Imposing the Weyl anomaly cancellation as a condition on the local renormalization group flow, we derive flow equations for the background couplings and the corresponding effective spacetime equations of motion, first in a two-derivative truncation, on a general curved background. We then consider a truncation to all orders in $\alpha'$, which captures only a subset of the possible tensor structures but is analytically tractable, in analogy with $f(R)$-like approximations. Within this truncation, we obtain Tseytlin's spacetime effective action, and we use it to study solutions to all orders in $\alpha'$, including black holes. Our results show that the functional renormalization group can be implemented on the string worldsheet and provide a framework to access the strong-curvature regime. As a longer-term goal, this may allow one to test the scenario of effective asymptotic safety in string theory, in which an approximately scale-invariant regime lies between the low-energy effective field theory and a stringy completion.
summary: 我们将泛函重正化群应用到玻色弦的世界表理论中。将 Weyl 异常抵消作为局部重正化群流的条件，我们推导出背景耦合的流方程和相应的有效时空运动方程，首先在一般弯曲背景上进行二阶导数截断。然后，我们考虑对 $\alpha'$ 中的所有阶进行截断，它仅捕获可能张量结构的子集，但在分析上易于处理，类似于 $f(R)$ 类近似。在这个截断内，我们获得了 Tseytlin 时空有效作用，并用它来研究 $\alpha'$ 中所有阶的解，包括黑洞。我们的结果表明，函数重整化群可以在弦世界表上实现，并提供访问强曲率状态的框架。作为一个长期目标，这可能允许人们测试弦理论中有效渐近安全的场景，其中近似尺度不变的状态位于低能有效场论和弦完成之间。

title: A New Holographic Duality for Conformal Mass Deformations
abstract: We construct a space-dependent conformal mass deformation of ABJM on the half-space $z>0$ and show that the vacua of this theory are dual to a large class of half-BPS bubbling solutions of the form $AdS_3\times S^3\times S^3\times\Sigma$, with superalgebra $D(2,1|\gamma)^{\oplus2}$, parametrized by $\gamma<0$. The conformal symmetry of a plane is preserved provided that the mass deformation scales as $m(z)=\frac{c}{z}$. We give the first field-theory explanation of the exceptional superalgebra parameter $\gamma$ in M2-brane field theory in terms of the coefficient of the inverse-distance mass deformation of ABJM: $\gamma=\frac{1-2c}{1+2c}$. We demonstrate this using the methods of Polchinski and Strassler, which we first apply to the Janus interfaces of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills and ABJM to relate localized mass sources to scalar matching conditions.
summary: 我们在半空间 $z>0$ 上构造了 ABJM 的空间相关共形质量变形，并表明该理论的真空与一大类半 BPS 冒泡解的对偶，其形式为 $AdS_3\times S^3\times S^3\times\Sigma$，具有超代数 $D(2,1|\gamma)^{\oplus2}$，参数化为 $\gamma<0$。如果质量变形按 $m(z)=\frac{c}{z}$ 缩放，则平面的共形对称性得以保留。我们用ABJM的反距离质量变形系数给出了M2膜场论中特殊超代数参数$\gamma$的第一个场论解释：$\gamma=\frac{1-2c}{1+2c}$。我们使用 Polchinski 和 Strassler 的方法演示了这一点，我们首先将其应用于 $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills 和 ABJM 的 Janus 接口，以将局部质量源与标量匹配条件相关联。

title: Chaos on the mass shell
abstract: We study particle production in high-energy states for theories given by an RG flow between an asymptotically free or conformal theory in the UV and a massive theory in the IR. Using the framework of detector matching, we argue that distributions of produced particles satisfy universal evolution equations with energy, determined by the spectrum of light-ray operators of the UV theory. In particular, we interpret the UV Chew-Frautschi plot as a wave equation for particle densities on the mass shell, evolving with energy. (When the UV theory is a CFT, this wave equation is the same one that controls the spread of chaos in hyperbolic space at a particular temperature.) We test these ideas for integrable flows in 2d CFTs, finding an independent derivation of the evolution equations in terms of the thermodynamics of a Feynman gas. We also discuss consequences for 4d gauge theories, including the presence of a BFKL contrail produced by an outgoing wave of hadron number density.
summary: 我们研究高能态下的粒子产生，以获得由紫外渐近自由或共形理论与红外质量理论之间的 RG 流给出的理论。使用探测器匹配的框架，我们认为产生的粒子的分布满足能量的普遍演化方程，能量由紫外线理论的光线算子的光谱决定。特别是，我们将 UV Chew-Frautschi 图解释为质量壳上粒子密度的波动方程，随能量演化。 （当 UV 理论是 CFT 时，该波动方程与控制特定温度下双曲空间中混沌传播的波动方程相同。）我们在 2d CFT 中测试了这些可积流的想法，找到了费曼气体热力学演化方程的独立推导。我们还讨论了 4d 规范理论的后果，包括由强子数密度传出波产生的 BFKL 轨迹的存在。

title: Inner Product of Closed Universe from Gravitational Path-integral
abstract: We construct the Hilbert space of a closed universe of fixed topology in anti-de Sitter (AdS) and de Sitter (dS) Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity from the gravitational path integral. Quantizing gravity involves several subtleties, including the choice of lapse contour, path-integral measure, operator ordering, global structure of the gauge group, the implementation of gravitational constraints and the gauge symmetries at initial and final timeslices. We develop a formalism that addresses these issues and determines the inner product of physical states, providing a framework to assign probabilities to cosmological wavefunctions. For a fixed topology and a lapse contour, we compute the inner product exactly and obtain the corresponding resolution of the identity in JT gravity. We demonstrate that the co-invariant and invariant Hilbert spaces in refined algebraic quantization arise from particular gauge fixing at the initial and final timeslices. In particular, the formalism provides precise meaning for a gravitational wavefunction with fixed geometric data as a co-invariant state, including its integral measure. These constructions can be formulated within the Hamiltonian BFV-BRST formalism. We also discuss the global structure of the Hilbert space, which differs from that of BF theory and depends on the prescription adopted near the big bang/crunch. Our results imply that the cylinder geometry captures the gravitational inner product for all perturbative states, including the Hartle-Hawking no-boundary state.
summary:
我们从引力路径积分构造反德西特 (AdS) 和德西特 (dS) Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力中固定拓扑的封闭宇宙的希尔伯特空间。量化重力涉及几个微妙之处，包括流逝轮廓的选择、路径积分测量、算子排序、规范组的全局结构、重力约束的实施以及初始和最终时间片的规范对称性。我们开发了一种形式主义来解决这些问题并确定物理状态的内积，提供一个为宇宙波函数分配概率的框架。对于固定拓扑和失效轮廓，我们精确计算内积并获得 JT 重力恒等式的相应分辨率。我们证明了精化代数量化中的协不变和不变希尔伯特空间源于初始和最终时间片的特定规范固定。特别是，该形式主义为具有固定几何数据的引力波函数作为共不变状态提供了精确的含义，包括其积分测度。

这些结构可以在哈密顿量 BFV-BRST 形式中表述。我们还讨论了希尔伯特空间的全局结构，它与 BF 理论不同，并且取决于大爆炸/紧缩附近采用的处方。我们的结果意味着圆柱体几何形状捕获了所有扰动状态的引力内积，包括哈特尔-霍金无边界状态。

title: A Sojourn Through $c=1$ String Theory
abstract: We revisit the $S$-matrix, the thermal $S$-matrix and the thermal free energy of $c=1$ string theory from the worldsheet perspective. By numerically integrating Virasoro conformal blocks with DOZZ structure constants, we compute the scattering amplitudes and thermal amplitudes up to 6-point at tree level and up to 3-point at one loop, in addition to the genus two thermal free energy. All results are in agreement with the predicted answers from the $c=1$ matrix model.
summary: 我们从世界表的角度重新审视 $S$ 矩阵、热 $S$ 矩阵和 $c=1$ 弦理论的热自由能。通过对 Virasoro 共形模块与 DOZZ 结构常数进行数值积分，我们计算了树级高达 6 点的散射幅度和热幅度，以及一个循环高达 3 点的散射幅度和热幅度，以及属二热自由能。所有结果都与 $c=1$ 矩阵模型的预测答案一致。

title: Compact holography via polarized IKKT
abstract: The polarized IKKT matrix model is a $U(N)$ supersymmetric matrix integral proposed to be dual to an $N$ D-instanton sector of Euclidean type IIB string theory. We show a direct path from matrix model saddles to supergravity saddles: matrix model resolvent $\to$ holomorphic function $\to$ 2D Coulomb potential $\to$ 4D Coulomb potential $\to$ supergravity fields, where the last step was previously described. Here, the 2D electrostatics picture is an exact finite $N$ reformulation of a localization deformation of the matrix model that gives a constrained gas of dipoles in a background field. We show a matching between supergravity and matrix model on-shell actions and protected observables for all saddles. We show that the supergravity saddles have a compact and non-singular metric in string frame with the Einstein frame asymptotic region replaced by a pointlike D-instanton source. We provide evidence that the physics of particular gravity saddles can be obtained through restricting the domain of the matrix model integral to a basin associated with the corresponding matrix model saddle. We describe certain large $N$ decoupling limits where families of the saddles decouple from the rest to give the gravity duals of certain higher-dimensional field theories.
summary:
极化 IKKT 矩阵模型是一个 $U(N)$ 超对称矩阵积分，建议与欧几里德 IIB 型弦理论的 $N$ D 瞬时扇区对偶。我们展示了从矩阵模型鞍座到超重力鞍座的直接路径：矩阵模型解析 $\to$ 全纯函数 $\to$ 2D 库仑势 $\to$ 4D 库仑势 $\to$ 超重力场，其中最后一步已在前面描述过。这里，二维静电图像是矩阵模型局部变形的精确有限 $N$ 重构，它给出了背景场中偶极子的约束气体。我们展示了超重力和矩阵模型壳上作用以及所有鞍座的受保护可观测量之间的匹配。我们证明超重力鞍在弦坐标系中具有紧凑的非奇异度量，爱因斯坦坐标系渐近区域被点状 D 瞬时源取代。我们提供的证据表明，可以通过将矩阵模型积分的域限制到与相应矩阵模型鞍相关的盆地来获得特定重力鞍的物理性质。

我们描述了某些大的$N$解耦极限，其中鞍座家族与其余部分解耦，以给出某些高维场论的引力对偶。

title: Resonant electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes
abstract: We construct nonlinear electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes in the bosonic Weinberg-Salam theory. These configurations are supported by harmonically time-dependent charged gauge fields, while their energy-momentum tensor remains static. Regularity at the horizon imposes a resonance condition relating the field frequency to the horizon electrostatic potential. Unlike linear clouds, these solutions exhibit a finite mass and electric charge gap, and exist only up to a maximal horizon size. We obtain both magnetic and electric clouds, including spherically symmetric and dipolar configurations, which reduce to electroweak balls in the vanishing-horizon limit. We also report a new family of dipolar electroweak balls, which can be energetically favoured over their spherical counterparts at fixed electric charge. Our results, obtained in the probe limit for electroweak couplings away from their measured values, establish a new realization of nonlinear resonant vector hair in a non-Abelian gauge-Higgs theory.
summary: 我们根据玻色温伯格-萨拉姆理论在史瓦西黑洞周围构建了非线性电弱云。这些配置由谐波时间相关的带电规范场支持，而它们的能量动量张量保持静态。地平线的规律性强加了将场频率与地平线静电势相关的共振条件。与线性云不同，这些解决方案表现出有限的质量和电荷间隙，并且仅存在于最大视界尺寸。我们获得了磁云和电云，包括球对称和偶极配置，它们在消失视界极限内减少为电弱球。我们还报告了一个新的偶极电弱球家族，它在固定电荷下比球形对应物更受青睐。我们的结果是在远离测量值的电弱耦合的探测极限中获得的，在非阿贝尔规范希格斯理论中建立了非线性共振矢量头发的新实现。

title: Reconstruction of the conformal algebra from a critical groundstate on the (fuzzy) sphere
abstract: Recently, we found a method to reconstruct the dilatation operator (sphere Hamiltonian) from a regulated conformal field theory groundstate. In this paper, we explore methods to construct the whole global conformal algebra, and test our construction using fuzzy sphere regularization. Starting from a groundstate of the same Hamiltonian, these methods perform better than constructions of the conformal generators based on a Hamiltonian density, are model-independent, require no additional tuning, and improve with system size. One purpose of reconstructing the conformal algebra is to identify conformal primary states, which we do with some success. We also find further evidence supporting the model of the short-distance corrections to the entanglement Hamiltonian proposed earlier and use it to make systematic improvements.
summary: 最近，我们找到了一种从受管制的共形场论基态重建膨胀算子（球哈密顿量）的方法。在本文中，我们探索了构造整个全局共形代数的方法，并使用模糊球正则化测试我们的构造。从同一哈密顿量的基态开始，这些方法比基于哈密顿量密度的共形生成器的构造表现得更好，与模型无关，不需要额外的调整，并且随着系统尺寸的增加而改进。重建共形代数的目的之一是识别共形主态，我们在这方面取得了一些成功。我们还找到了支持之前提出的纠缠哈密顿量短距离修正模型的进一步证据，并用它来进行系统改进。

title: A lattice construction of the Kormos-Runkel-Watts defect flows in minimal models
abstract: Kormos, Runkel, and Watts (KRW) showed that a topological defect of a diagonal minimal model $M(p,p+1)$, perturbed by a weakly relevant defect field, flows to a new conformal interface. We study the flow of the $(2,1)$ Verlinde defect $D_{(2,1)}$ driven by the spinful defect field $\phi_{(1,3)}\otimes\bar\phi_{(3,3)}$ on the lattice. The flow preserves the $(r,1)$ Verlinde lines. This preserved symmetry makes a dilute RSOS realisation possible. We study this flow numerically using both exact diagonalization and density matrix renormalization group (DMRG). At $p=4$, the flow ends on the invertible line $\eta=D_{(3,1)}$. At $p=5$ it ends on a non-trivial conformal interface $C_5$ with $g=1.503(2)$ and transmission coefficient $T=0.665(10)$. We report its spectrum, leading irrelevant dimension, and lattice $\beta$-function. Gauging $\eta$ maps $C_5$ to an interface of the three-state Potts model, which breaks $\mathbb{Z}_3$ but is a stable interface once the Fibonacci line $\tau_{\mathrm{Fib}}$ and charge conjugation are imposed. A loop-model formulation allows us to follow the family $C_p$ at continuous $4\le p\le5$: it moves smoothly from $C_5$ to $\eta$ as we lower $p$.
summary: Kormos、Runkel 和 Watts (KRW) 表明，对角最小模型 $M(p,p+1)$ 的拓扑缺陷受到弱相关缺陷场的扰动，流向新的共形界面。我们研究晶格上自旋缺陷场 $\phi_{(1,3)}\otimes\bar\phi_{(3,3)}$ 驱动的 $(2,1)$ Verlinde 缺陷 $D_{(2,1)}$ 的流动。该流程保留 $(r,1)$ Verlinde 线。这种保留的对称性使得稀释 RSOS 的实现成为可能。我们使用精确对角化和密度矩阵重正化群 (DMRG) 来数值研究该流。在 $p=4$ 处，流程在可逆线 $\eta=D_{(3,1)}$ 上结束。在 $p=5$ 处，它结束于一个非平凡的共形接口 $C_5$，其中 $g=1.503(2)$ 和传输系数 $T=0.665(10)$。我们报告了它的谱、主导不相关维数和格$\beta$函数。测量 $\eta$ 将 $C_5$ 映射到三态 Potts 模型的接口，该接口破坏了 $\mathbb{Z}_3$，但一旦施加斐波那契线 $\tau_{\mathrm{Fib}}$ 和电荷共轭，它就是一个稳定的接口。循环模型公式允许我们在连续的 $4\le p\le5$ 处遵循 $C_p$ 族：当我们降低 $p$ 时，它从 $C_5$ 平滑地移动到 $\eta$。

title: From off-shell strings to entropy flows
abstract: Bit threads express holographic entropy as the maximal flux of a divergenceless vector field subject to a local capacity bound, but do not identify a physical carrier of that flux. In our previous work, we identified the projected string charge density with a bit-thread flow, reproduced the entropies of BTZ and ten-dimensional three-charge black holes, and showed that the maximal entropy flux is preserved under S- and T-dualities. However, the norm bound was imported from the bit-thread prescription, while the string-current configurations were prescribed along known bit-thread lines. In this paper, we give a stringy foundation for the local capacity and construct dynamical probe-string representatives of maximal flow. At genus zero and two-derivative order, the conical variation of the target-space action derived from the off-shell sphere fixes the string-frame entropy density. The gravitational replica construction and weighted flow-cut duality then yield the string-frame norm bound. We next find regular stationary F1 solutions in an NS-NS supported BTZ black hole whose spatial parts are logarithmic spirals. A uniform ensemble produces a conserved, constant-norm projected string charge density and realizes a maximal flow whose flux equals the BTZ entropy. We finally extend the construction to BTZ backgrounds with mixed NS-NS and RR flux. Varying the flux fraction changes the stationary F1 configurations at fixed metric and dilaton, while the corresponding conserved flows reproduce the same leading BTZ entropy. Thus, both the norm bound and its physical maximal-flow representative arise from string theory, with stationary strings providing physical channels for the entropic flux represented geometrically by bit threads.
summary:
位线程将全息熵表示为受局部容量限制的无发散矢量场的最大通量，但不识别该通量的物理载体。在我们之前的工作中，我们用位线流识别了投影的弦电荷密度，再现了 BTZ 和十维三电荷黑洞的熵，并表明最大熵通量在 S 和 T 对偶性下保持不变。然而，范数界限是从位线规定中导入的，而串电流配置是沿着已知的位线线规定的。在本文中，我们为局部容量提供了弦基础，并构造了最大流的动态探针弦代表。在亏格零和二阶导数阶上，从离壳球体导出的目标空间作用的圆锥变化固定了弦系熵密度。然后，引力复制品结构和加权流切对偶性产生弦框架范数界限。接下来，我们在 NS-NS 支持的 BTZ 黑洞中找到常规平稳 F1 解，其空间部分是对数螺线。

均匀系综产生守恒、恒定范数的投影弦电荷密度，并实现通量等于 BTZ 熵的最大流。我们最终将结构扩展到具有混合 NS-NS 和 RR 通量的 BTZ 背景。改变通量分数会改变固定公制和膨胀量下的固定 F1 配置，而相应的守恒流会再现相同的领先 BTZ 熵。因此，范数界及其物理最大流表示都源自弦理论，其中固定弦为由位线程几何表示的熵通量提供物理通道。

title: Exotic Pauli spinors and magnetic flux quantization in a superconducting ring
abstract: We develop the formalism of the exotic Pauli equation and establish an effective symmetry between standard and exotic Pauli spinors to describe magnetic flux quantization in a superconducting ring within the nonrelativistic framework. We show that, once the signs of the spatial and temporal topological terms are fixed consistently by the covariant exotic Dirac equation, this symmetry is exact at the level of the equations of motion, Lagrangians and currents, with no truncation of the exotic term and no condition on the time dependence of the topological phase. Upon deriving the flux quantization condition, we explicitly construct the composite matter-gauge unitary operator acting on the Hilbert space, which implements the symmetry at the quantum level (the gauge sector requiring the usual regularization).
summary: 我们开发了奇异泡利方程的形式，并在标准和奇异泡利旋量之间建立了有效的对称性，以描述非相对论框架内超导环中的磁通量量子化。我们证明，一旦空间和时间拓扑项的符号被协变奇异狄拉克方程一致地固定，这种对称性在运动方程、拉格朗日方程和电流方程的层面上是精确的，没有奇异项的截断，也没有拓扑相位时间依赖性的条件。在推导通量量化条件后，我们显式地构造了作用于希尔伯特空间的复合物质规范酉算子，它实现了量子级别的对称性（规范扇区需要通常的正则化）。

title: Hamiltonian of open string field theory for time-dependent solutions
abstract: Using the recently introduced expression for conserved charges of $L_\infty$ theories, we give an explicit form for the Hamiltonian of Witten's bosonic open string field theory. We evaluate it on the Erler-Maccaferri analytic solution, describing any D$p$-brane configuration associated to a BCFT. We use the expression to compute the energy of the rolling tachyon solution and find exact agreement with the boundary state result by Sen.
summary: 使用最近引入的 $L_\infty$ 理论的守恒电荷表达式，我们给出了威滕玻色开弦场理论的哈密顿量的显式形式。我们在 Erler-Maccaferri 解析解上对其进行评估，描述与 BCFT 相关的任何 D$p$-膜配置。我们使用该表达式来计算滚动快子解的能量，并发现与 Sen 的边界态结果完全一致。

title: Obstruction to local entropy laws on arbitrary black-hole cuts in five-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity
abstract: We study local entropy laws on arbitrary cuts of event horizons in five-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity, treated as an exact theory. No covariant local entropy can both reproduce the stationary black-hole entropy and be nondecreasing between every ordered pair of cuts, provided its density is smooth on an invariant open set of off-shell metric and cut jets containing a flat planar cut and every cut used in the argument. No global bound on derivative order is assumed. The counterexamples to the second law are vacuum black holes perturbed by a gravitational wave, with a strongly hyperbolic formulation near the relevant horizon interval and its stationary future. Shear makes the intrinsic curvature of a cut depend on its bending. The stationary entropy fixes the coefficient of this curvature term, and local corrections cannot cancel its response to cut bending. The obstruction appears at second order in wave amplitude on a smooth horizon, without a merger or topology change.
summary: 我们研究五维爱因斯坦-高斯-邦内引力中事件视界任意切割的局域熵定律，将其视为精确理论。没有协变局部熵既可以再现稳态黑洞熵，又可以在每个有序切割对之间不递减，只要它的密度在包含平坦平面切割和论证中使用的每个切割的离壳度量和切割射流的不变开放集上是平滑的。假设导数阶没有全局界限。第二定律的反例是受到引力波扰动的真空黑洞，在相关视界区间及其静止未来附近具有强双曲公式。剪切使切口的固有曲率取决于其弯曲。稳态熵固定了该曲率项的系数，并且局部校正不能取消其对切割弯曲的响应。障碍物在平滑地平线上以二阶波幅出现，没有合并或拓扑变化。

title: Hermitian matrix-valued nonlocal deformation of the SU($N$) Thirring model at large $N$
abstract: We investigate a Hermitian matrix-valued nonlocal deformation of the two-dimensional $SU(N)$ Thirring model at leading order in $1/N$. We impose $f(\slashed{\partial})^\ddagger=f(\slashed{\partial})$ directly on the original action; for real nonlocality scale the admissible exponential choice is $f(\slashed{\partial})=\exp[-i\slashed{\partial}/\Lambda]$. We construct and analyze the even-in-mass (paired) large-$N$ effective potential and derive its radial kernel, weak-coupling dimensional-transmutation scale, and formal Lambert-$W$ zeros. Its radial gap integral possesses a conditionally convergent infinite-cutoff limit. The pairing prescription, however, differs from the unpaired determinant of the original Hermitian action, so the reported gap and spectral zeros must be understood as properties of this explicitly defined mean-field functional. We identify the further derivation needed to obtain physical mass gaps and fermion poles from the unpaired theory.
summary: 我们研究了二维 $SU(N)$ Thirring 模型的 Hermitian 矩阵值非局部变形，其首阶为 $1/N$。我们直接对原始动作施加 $f(\slashed{\partial})^\ddagger=f(\slashed{\partial})$ ；对于真正的非定域尺度，可接受的指数选择是 $f(\slashed{\partial})=\exp[-i\slashed{\partial}/\Lambda]$。我们构建并分析了偶数质量（成对）大$N$有效势，并推导出其径向核、弱耦合维度嬗变尺度和形式朗伯-$W$零点。其径向间隙积分具有条件收敛的无限截止极限。然而，配对规定与原始埃尔米特作用的未配对行列式不同，因此报告的间隙和谱零点必须被理解为这种明确定义的平均场泛函的属性。我们确定了从不成对理论获得物理质量间隙和费米子极点所需的进一步推导。

title: A Ghost-Free dS/AdS Correspondence in $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity
abstract: Reversing the sign of the scalar potential exchanges de Sitter and anti-de Sitter vacua and, through the domain-wall/cosmology correspondence, maps flat domain walls onto flat FLRW cosmologies, but its supersymmetric version has ghosts on the cosmological side. We show that this pointwise correspondence is realized between two ordinary, ghost-free four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravities with spontaneously broken supersymmetry. Within a single superconformal Kähler cone, a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ reflection of the nilpotent goldstino Kähler metric through the flat limit $V=0$ reverses $V\leftrightarrow-V$ pointwise while preserving the visible Kähler metric, the superpotential, and the unitary-gauge fermion Lagrangian. The paired vacua obey a sharp dictionary with $H=1/L$, $m^2_{\rm dS}=-m^2_{\rm AdS}$, equal conformal weights, and $m_{3/2}>H$, and are simultaneously stable precisely within the window $0\le m^2_{\rm dS}\le\frac94H^2$ set by the Breitenlohner--Freedman bound. Applied to string compactifications and cosmology, this correspondence pairs over-uplifted with under-uplifted anti-D3-brane vacua, confines the de Sitter swampland conjecture to the goldstino (anti-brane) sector, and maps slow-roll inflation onto a healthy AdS domain wall obeying the holographic $c$-theorem.
summary:
反转标量势交换德西特和反德西特真空的符号，并通过畴壁/宇宙学对应，将平坦的畴壁映射到平坦的 FLRW 宇宙学上，但其超对称版本在宇宙学方面有幽灵。我们证明，这种逐点对应是在两个普通的、无鬼影的四维 $\mathcal{N}=1$ 超引力之间实现的，并且具有自发破缺的超对称性。在单个超共形凯勒锥体内，幂函数金斯蒂诺凯勒度量通过平坦极限 $V=0$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 反射逐点反转 $V\leftrightarrow-V$，同时保留可见的凯勒度量、超势和酉规范费米子拉格朗日。成对真空服从尖锐字典，其中 $H=1/L$、$m^2_{\rm dS}=-m^2_{\rm AdS}$、相等的保形权重和 $m_{3/2}>H$，并且同时在由 Breitenlohner-Freedman 边界设置的窗口 $0\le m^2_{\rm dS}\le\frac94H^2$ 内精确稳定。

应用于弦紧化和宇宙学，这种对应关系将过度抬升与反抬升不足的反 D3 膜真空配对，将德西特沼泽地猜想限制在 Goldstino（反膜）扇区，并将慢滚膨胀映射到遵守全息 $c$ 定理的健康 AdS 域墙上。

title: Negative Junction Logarithms in Scalar Multipartite Entanglement
abstract: A three-region junction in a free real relativistic scalar vacuum in $2+1$ dimensions yields a strictly negative logarithmic contribution to genuine tripartite Rényi multi-entropy for every integer $n\geq3$ and all nondegenerate sector angles. The replica subtraction exactly removes loop classes associated with a single interface. Surviving loops have positive, scale-independent weight, yielding a logarithm whose sign is fixed by the negative Rényi prefactor. The selector is empty at $n=2$. The flat-sheet Friedrichs prescription fixes the scalar operator at the nonmanifold replica apex. It yields a convergent angular spectral formula for the coefficient.
summary: 对于每个整数 $n\geq3$ 和所有非简并扇形角度，自由实相对论标量真空中 $2+1$ 维度的三区域结对真正的三方 Rényi 多熵产生严格负对数贡献。副本减法精确地删除了与单个接口关联的循环类。幸存的循环具有正的、与尺度无关的权重，产生一个其符号由负的 Rényi 前因子固定的对数。选择器在 $n=2$ 处为空。平板弗里德里希处方将标量算子固定在非流形复制品顶点。它产生系数的收敛角谱公式。

title: On the universality of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory
abstract: The standard definition of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory requires regularizing the entangling surface and factorizing the Hilbert space, which in turn involves a choice of boundary conditions at the regularized surface. This raises two natural questions which are open at present. The first is under what conditions there is a choice of boundary conditions that leads to a unitary map between the original Hilbert space and the factorized one, which is a necessary condition for a well-defined entanglement entropy. The second concerns the situation where there are multiple such choices, in which case the question is whether they all yield the same entropy, or at least the same terms usually referred to as universal. Focusing on topological theories and using three-dimensional Chern-Simons theory as a concrete illustration, we show under specified assumptions that different such choices affect only the non-universal terms in the entropy, such that the remaining terms are universal in this sense as well, while we explicitly demonstrate that boundary conditions corresponding to non-unitary maps can change these terms. We then explain how a similar argument applies to two-dimensional conformal field theories and discuss a condition for universality in general theories.
summary:
量子场论中纠缠熵的标准定义需要正则化纠缠表面并分解希尔伯特空间，这又涉及正则化表面边界条件的选择。这就提出了两个目前尚未解决的自然问题。第一个是在什么条件下选择边界条件，从而导致原始希尔伯特空间和因式分解空间之间的酉映射，这是明确定义的纠缠熵的必要条件。第二个涉及存在多个此类选择的情况，在这种情况下，问题是它们是否都产生相同的熵，或者至少是通常被称为通用的相同术语。以拓扑理论为中心，以三维陈-西蒙斯理论为具体例证，我们在特定的假设下证明，不同的选择只影响熵中的非普适项，因此其余项在这个意义上也是普适的，同时我们明确证明了与非酉映射对应的边界条件可以改变这些项。

然后，我们解释类似的论证如何应用于二维共形场论，并讨论一般理论中普遍性的条件。

title: Gauge-invariant thermodynamic description of rotating black strings in 5D minimal supergravity via Kaluza-Klein reduction
abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant formulation of the thermodynamics of rotating black strings in five-dimensional minimal supergravity through Kaluza-Klein reduction. At the two-derivative level, we consistently reduce the bulk action and the Gibbons-Hawking-York boundary term, carefully accounting for the surface contributions induced by the Chern-Simons coupling. The resulting four-dimensional theory is $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity coupled to a single vector multiplet, with prepotential $P=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{3}}\frac{X_1^3}{X_0}$. Employing the Hamiltonian formalism, we establish the quantum statistical relation between the Euclidean on-shell action and the Gibbs free energy. We further compute the leading four-derivative corrections to the thermodynamics of a rotating magnetic black string using the Reall-Santos method. The resulting corrections are in precise agreement with previous results obtained directly for the Kerr-Newman black hole in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity.
summary: 我们通过 Kaluza-Klein 还原开发了五维最小超重力下旋转黑弦热力学的规范不变公式。在二阶导数水平上，我们不断减少体作用和吉本斯-霍金-约克边界项，仔细考虑陈-西蒙斯耦合引起的表面贡献。由此产生的四维理论是 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超重力耦合到单个向量多重态，具有预势 $P=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{3}}\frac{X_1^3}{X_0}$。利用哈密顿形式主义，我们建立了欧几里德壳上作用和吉布斯自由能之间的量子统计关系。我们进一步使用 Reall-Santos 方法计算旋转磁性黑弦热力学的主要四导数修正。由此产生的修正与之前在四维 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超重力下直接为克尔-纽曼黑洞获得的结果完全一致。

title: Circuit Complexity of Scalar and Tensor Perturbations in Luminal Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Inflation
abstract: We investigate the circuit complexity of primordial scalar and tensor perturbations in the luminal branch of Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet inflation. Starting from the quadratic perturbation actions, we construct the two-mode Hamiltonians and derive the evolution equations for the squeezing amplitudes and angles. Although the tensor speed is fixed to unity, the Gauss--Bonnet (GB) coupling remains dynamical through the scalar and tensor pump fields. We track the squeezing dynamics from the subhorizon to the superhorizon regime and evaluate the Nielsen wave-function complexity of the resulting two-mode squeezed states. The GB correction produces a clear separation in the squeezing amplitudes, while the unwrapped squeezing angles remain nearly phase locked. Consequently, the circuit complexity is controlled mainly by the amplitude evolution. A positive coupling enhances the scalar complexity but slightly suppresses the tensor complexity for the benchmarks considered. These opposite trends show that scalar and tensor Gaussian states retain distinct information about the same modified inflationary background even when tensor propagation is luminal.
summary: 我们研究了爱因斯坦-高斯-邦尼暴胀管腔分支中原初标量和张量扰动的电路复杂性。从二次扰动作用出发，我们构造了双模哈密顿量并推导了挤压幅度和角度的演化方程。尽管张量速度固定为单位，但高斯-邦内特 (GB) 耦合通过标量和张量泵浦场保持动态。我们跟踪从地平线以下到超地平线区域的压缩动力学，并评估由此产生的双模压缩态的尼尔森波函数复杂性。 GB 校正在挤压幅度中产生明显的分离，而展开的挤压角保持几乎锁相。因此，电路复杂性主要由幅度演变控制。正耦合增强了标量复杂性，但略微抑制了所考虑基准的张量复杂性。这些相反的趋势表明，即使张量传播是光速的，标量和张量高斯态仍保留有关相同修改的膨胀背景的不同信息。

title: Regge bounds and eikonal scaling in a four-dimensional scalar EFT
abstract: Positivity bounds rest on twice-subtracted dispersion relations, which assume that the amplitude grows more slowly than $s^2$. For the massless shift-symmetric scalar with $g_4(\partial\phi)^4/\Lambda^4$ and $g_6(\partial\phi)^6/\Lambda^8$, we derive the dispersion relation, whose cuts start at zero energy, and study the large-$s$ growth at fixed $t<0$ of the tree, the one-loop bubble and the three-loop banana. The partial-wave sum is split at a transition spin: low spins are bounded by unitarity, channel by channel, and high spins are evaluated with the eikonal phase of the crossed-channel logarithms by stationary phase. The same construction is applied in the forward limit required by the dispersion relation, and we use the one- and three-loop absorptive parts below the cutoff to constrain $g_4$ and $g_6$.
summary: 正边界依赖于两次减去色散关系，该关系假设振幅增长得比 $s^2$ 慢。对于$g_4(\partial\phi)^4/\Lambda^4$和$g_6(\partial\phi)^6/\Lambda^8$的无质量平移对称标量，我们推导了从零能量开始切割的色散关系，并研究了树、单环气泡和三环香蕉在固定$t<0$处的大$s$增长。部分波和在跃迁自旋处分裂：低自旋由酉性、通道至通道所界定，而高自旋则通过稳定相用跨通道对数的 eikonal 相位来评估。同样的结构也适用于色散关系所需的前向极限，我们使用截止以下的一环和三环吸收部分来约束$g_4$和$g_6$。

title: Modular properties of correlators in generalised Gibbs ensembles
abstract: We study the modular properties of torus correlators in a generalised Gibbs ensemble (GGE) of a two-dimensional conformal field theory. For the free fermion with KdV charges, we compute the exact two-point function and derive its modular $S$-transformation as a formal power series in the chemical potential. The transformed correlator admits a factorised description: an effective charge deforms the ensemble, while a local dressing operator acts on the external fields. Both are determined by nested operator product expansions involving the deforming current. Motivated by this result, we conjecture an analogous transformation law for $n$-point functions in rational chiral conformal field theories. Using Zhu's recursion, we establish the conjecture at the lowest explicit power of the modular parameter to all orders in the chemical potential, thereby determining the dressing operator. We also verify the full conjectured transformation through cubic order in the chemical potential, retaining all explicit powers of the modular parameter. These results extend the nested-OPE description of modular transformations of GGE partition functions to local correlation functions.
summary: 我们研究了二维共形场论的广义吉布斯系综（GGE）中环面相关器的模特性。对于带有 KdV 电荷的自由费米子，我们计算精确的两点函数，并导出其模块化 $S$ 变换作为化学势的形式幂级数。变换后的相关器允许因式分解描述：有效电荷使系综变形，而局部修整算子作用于外部场。两者都是由涉及变形电流的嵌套算子乘积展开确定的。受此结果的启发，我们推测有理手性共形场论中 $n$ 点函数的类似变换定律。利用朱氏递推，我们建立了化学势所有阶模参数的最低显式幂下的猜想，从而确定了选矿算子。我们还通过化学势的立方阶验证了完整的猜想变换，保留了模参数的所有显式幂。这些结果将 GGE 划分函数的模变换的嵌套 OPE 描述扩展到局部相关函数。

title: Scalar radiation from circular orbits in D3 brane spacetimes: a Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi-like approach
abstract: We study scalar perturbations in a ten-dimensional D3 brane spacetime, developing a (higher-dimensional) Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi-like formalism adapted to the present case leading to a sourced modification of a Mathieu equation. As an application, we compute the energy loss both at infinity and at the horizon in terms of scalar waves due to a scalar charge moving along a circular "equatorial" geodesic.
summary: 我们研究 10 维 D3 膜时空中的标量扰动，开发了一种适合当前情况的（更高维）Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi 式形式主义，从而对 Mathieu 方程进行了源修改。作为一个应用，我们计算了由于标量电荷沿着圆形“赤道”测地线移动而导致的无穷远和地平线处的能量损失。

title: The Stringy Origin of Kerr Multipoles
abstract: We construct a new family of exact open and closed bosonic string solutions in flat spacetime that reproduce the root-Kerr and Kerr multipoles at every fixed multipole order in the large-mass and large-angular-momentum limit. These solutions provide explicit classical data for identifying associated quantum string states and testing their correspondence with rotating black holes.
summary: 我们在平坦时空中构造了一系列新的精确开闭玻色弦解，在大质量和大角动量极限下，在每个固定多极阶上重现根克尔和克尔多极子。这些解决方案提供了明确的经典数据，用于识别相关的量子弦状态并测试它们与旋转黑洞的对应关系。

title: Fortuitous BMN Operators from Multiple Cores
abstract: We develop a systematic construction of fortuitous cohomology classes in the BMN sector of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory from multiple lower-rank building blocks. For arbitrary partitions of colour space, we construct corrected effective letters that obey the supersymmetry transformations of the corresponding lower-rank theories. These allow us to build gauge-invariant, $Q$-closed polynomial operators. A restriction map recovers the constituent cohomology classes, establishing non-exactness and fortuity without brute-force computations. As an explicit example, we combine two fortuitous $SU(2)$ cores to construct a fortuitous class in $SU(4)$. Our results provide a systematic approach to the structure of fortuitous cohomology at finite $N$.
summary: 我们从多个低阶构建块中开发了 $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills 理论的 BMN 扇区中偶然上同调类的系统构造。对于颜色空间的任意分区，我们构造了遵循相应低阶理论的超对称变换的校正有效字母。这些使我们能够构建规范不变、$Q$ 闭多项式运算符。限制图恢复组成的上同调类，无需强力计算即可建立非精确性和偶然性。作为一个明确的例子，我们结合两个偶然的 $SU(2)$ 核心在 $SU(4)$ 中构造一个偶然的类。我们的结果为有限 $N$ 下的偶然上同调结构提供了一种系统方法。

title: Crossover from Schwarzian dynamics to rotational soft modes in near-extremal Lovelock black holes
abstract: Near-extremal black holes are controlled by a small set of soft modes, and counting these modes fixes the coefficient of $\log T$ in the entropy. We ask whether genuine six-derivative interactions change that count, working in seven-dimensional third-order Lovelock gravity, the simplest setting where the cubic Lovelock term is dynamical. The multiplicities stay the same, but the naive count fails. At fixed charge the Maxwell mode is frozen out, and the fifteen rotational modes of the $S^5$ act as a quantum rotor that only switches on above the scale $K_J^{-1}$. As a result, the coefficient of $\log T$ runs from $3/2$ at the lowest temperatures to $9$ above that scale, and never reaches the naive Gaussian value $19/2$. We compute the moment of inertia $K_J$ from the charged slow-rotation solution and find that the Lovelock couplings move the crossover without changing the multiplicities. Only large AdS black holes have a wide window in which the full rotational contribution competes with the classical entropy. Adding a probe charged scalar, we derive an analytic near-horizon Schwinger threshold in the cubic coupling. Its large-AdS limit tells us when the broad rotational crossover window can coexist with the absence of a charged-scalar Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound violation.
summary:
近极值黑洞由一小组软模式控制，对这些模式进行计数可以固定熵中的 $\log T$ 系数。我们询问，在七维三阶洛夫洛克引力（立方洛夫洛克项是动态的最简单的设置）下，真正的六导数相互作用是否会改变计数。重数保持不变，但天真的计数失败了。在固定电荷下，麦克斯韦模式被冻结，$S^5$ 的 15 个旋转模式充当量子转子，仅在 $K_J^{-1}$ 刻度上方开启。因此，$\log T$ 的系数从最低温度下的 $3/2$ 到高于该范围的 $9$，并且永远不会达到朴素高斯值 $19/2$。我们根据带电慢速旋转解计算转动惯量 $K_J$，发现 Lovelock 联轴器在不改变重数的情况下移动分频器。只有大的 AdS 黑洞才具有宽窗口，其中全旋转贡献与经典熵竞争。添加探针带电标量，我们得出三次耦合中的解析近地平施温格阈值。

它的大 AdS 限制告诉我们何时宽旋转交叉窗口可以与不存在带电标量 Breitenlohner-Freedman (BF) 界违规共存。

title: Interpolating between 4d $\mathcal{N}= 1$ SCFT supercurrent multiplet anomalies
abstract: A renormalized SCFT can be coupled to a number of background off-shell supergravity multiplets, defining different current multiplets and superconformal anomalies. We focus on the relation between the conformal and Ferrara-Zumino multiplets of generic $\mathcal{N}= 1$ SCFTs in four dimensions, defined respectively by $\mathcal{N}= 1$ conformal and old-minimal supergravity. We show that the conformal super-gravity partition function, when lifted to a functional of the old-minimal background fields through a suitable Wess-Zumino action, is related to the old-minimal partition function by a local counterterm that we determine explicitly in components. This counterterm interpolates between two different old-minimal supergravity schemes with different superconformal anomalies. Part of the counterterm depends on the old-minimal auxiliary scalar and provides the explicit component form of the super-space counterterm constructed in [1]. However, the full counterterm that interpolates between the two multiplets contains additional terms, independent of the old-minimal auxiliary scalar, which are not present in this superspace counterterm. These additional terms play a key role in the comparison of physical observables between the two multiplets.
summary:
重正化 SCFT 可以与多个背景离壳超重力多重态耦合，定义不同的当前多重态和超共形异常。我们重点关注四个维度中通用 $\mathcal{N}= 1$ SCFT 的共形和 Ferrara-Zumino 多重态之间的关系，分别由 $\mathcal{N}= 1$ 共形和旧最小超重力定义。我们证明，当通过适当的 Wess-Zumino 作用提升为旧最小背景场的函数时，共形超重力配分函数通过我们在组件中明确确定的局部反项与旧最小配分函数相关。这个反项在具有不同超共形异常的两个不同的旧最小超重力方案之间进行插值。部分反项依赖于旧的最小辅助标量，并提供[1]中构造的超空间反项的显式分量形式。然而，在两个多重态之间插值的完整反项包含附加项，独立于旧的最小辅助标量，这些项不存在于该超空间反项中。

这些附加项在两个多重态之间的物理可观测量的比较中起着关键作用。

title: Weyl Rescalings: A First Order Approach
abstract: Weyl transformations, --local rescalings in which the metric transforms as $g_{\mu\nu}(x)\longrightarrow \Omega^2(x)\, g_{\mu \nu}(x)$--, are expected to be a symmetry of nature at extremely high energy, that should be (spontaneously) broken at low energy. In Cartan's first order formulation of gravity this translates into the condition that the local frames (vielbein) scale as $e^a(x) \longrightarrow \Omega(x) e^a(x)$. In this construction, the Lorentz connection one-form fields $\omega^a{}_b$ are independent from $e^a$, and since Lorentz transformations and dilatations commute, $\omega$ and $R(\omega)$ must be Weyl invariant, while in the second order metric formalism the Ricci tensor undergoes a non-homogeneous transformation. This generates a tension between the two formulations, which should be equivalent in the vanishing torsion limit. Here we show how the puzzle can be resolved taking into account the role of torsion. This also sheds some light on the conformal coupling of matter fields to gravity.
summary: 韦尔变换，--局部重新缩放，其中度量变换为 $g_{\mu\nu}(x)\longrightarrow \Omega^2(x)\, g_{\mu \nu}(x)$--，预计在极高能量下是自然的对称性，在低能量下应该（自发地）破缺。在嘉当的一阶引力公式中，这转化为局部框架 (vielbein) 缩放为 $e^a(x) \longrightarrow \Omega(x) e^a(x)$ 的条件。在此构造中，洛伦兹连接一式域 $\omega^a{}_b$ 独立于 $e^a$，并且由于洛伦兹变换和膨胀交换，$\omega$ 和 $R(\omega)$ 必须是 Weyl 不变的，而在二阶度量形式中，Ricci 张量经历非齐次变换。这会在两个公式之间产生张力，该张力在消失的扭转极限中应该是相等的。在这里，我们展示了如何在考虑扭转作用的情况下解决这个难题。这也为物质场与重力的共形耦合提供了一些线索。

title: Hecke Relations from Self-Duality
abstract: Hecke operators can be used to relate characters of rational conformal field theories with different central charges, but it has remained a mystery how to interpret these relations physically. We offer a simple explanation in terms of self-duality under asymmetric orbifolds. Self-dual orbifolds also give more general identities beyond the familiar Harvey-Wu construction, which we illustrate through examples.
summary: 赫克算子可用于将有理共形场论的特征与不同的中心电荷联系起来，但如何在物理上解释这些关系仍然是一个谜。我们根据非对称轨道折叠下的自对偶性提供了一个简单的解释。自对偶轨道折叠还提供了超越熟悉的 Harvey-Wu 结构的更一般的恒等式，我们通过示例进行说明。

title: Horizon exchange and the universal all-spin response of Kerr
abstract: The radial Teukolsky equation is invariant under exchange of the outer and inner horizons, although the physical boundary condition is not. We derive an exact monodromy relation between the corresponding Mano--Suzuki--Takasugi (MST) near-zone responses. At leading order in frequency and to all orders in spin, this relation yields, for every multipole, an expression for the leading horizon-exchange-odd response. For gravitational perturbations, it determines the exchange-odd contribution to quadrupolar absorption and organizes the exchange-even dynamical response into a digamma function whose expansion accounts for the odd- and even-zeta structures found in Kerr-Compton calculations. The exact relation, rather than the individual previously known small-spin coefficients, is the central result.
summary: 尽管物理边界条件并非如此，但径向 Teukolsky 方程在外部和内部视界交换的情况下保持不变。我们推导出相应的 Mano--Suzuki--Takasugi (MST) 近区响应之间的精确单向关系。在频率的前导阶和自旋的所有阶中，对于每个多极，该关系产生前导视界交换奇响应的表达式。对于引力扰动，它确定奇数交换对四极吸收的贡献，并将交换偶数动态响应组织成双伽马函数，其展开解释了克尔-康普顿计算中发现的奇数和偶数 zeta 结构。核心结果是精确的关系，而不是先前已知的各个小自旋系数。

title: A Holographic Weyl Semimetal in an Effective Gauss--Bonnet Geometry
abstract: We study how an effective Gauss--Bonnet deformation of the thermal geometry changes the competition between the conducting Weyl-semimetal and insulating flavour phases of the probe D3/D7 model. The phases are represented by horizon-reaching and smoothly capped D7 embeddings, respectively, whose free energies exhibit a first-order transition. At the temperatures examined, positive Gauss--Bonnet coupling shifts coexistence toward larger flavour mass and expands the thermodynamically preferred Weyl-semimetal region, while negative coupling shifts the boundary in the opposite direction. The normalized zero-temperature transition remains unchanged. An on-shell analysis shows that the leading finite-temperature shift is largely explained by an effective rescaling of the thermal scale, opposed by an intrinsic fixed-horizon geometric contribution. The enlargement of the conducting phase does not imply stronger electrical response: the longitudinal and anomalous Hall conductivity jumps at coexistence can decrease, and the coupling response of the longitudinal jump reverses with temperature. The mass-dependent maximum of the longitudinal DC conductivity can also cease to occur on the thermodynamically preferred branch. Thus the geometric deformation changes both which phase is favored and how the Weyl-semimetal phase conducts.
summary:
我们研究了热几何结构的有效高斯-阀帽变形如何改变探针 D3/D7 模型的导电 Weyl 半金属相和绝缘风味相之间的竞争。这些阶段分别由到达地平线的 D7 嵌入和平滑上限的 D7 嵌入表示，其自由能表现出一阶跃迁。在所检测的温度下，正高斯-博内特耦合将共存转向更大的风味质量并扩大热力学上优选的外尔半金属区域，而负耦合则将边界向相反方向移动。归一化的零温度转变保持不变。壳上分析表明，主要的有限温度变化很大程度上是通过热尺度的有效重新调整来解释的，而不是内在的固定范围几何贡献。导电相的增大并不意味着更强的电响应：共存时的纵向和反常霍尔电导率跳跃会减小，并且纵向跳跃的耦合响应随温度反转。

纵向直流电导率的质量相关最大值也可能不再出现在热力学优选分支上。因此，几何变形既改变了有利的相，也改变了外尔半金属相的传导方式。

title: From Z to all: cyclic sum rules for thermal CFT partition functions
abstract: The high-temperature expansion of twisted $S^{d-1}\times S^1$ partition functions of CFT$_d$, $d = 2\kappa$, has recently been shown to obey an infinite tower of universal constraints. We determine these constraints explicitly and demonstrate that they can be packaged into a single equation involving a large conformal diffeomorphism isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_{\kappa+1}$, which cyclically permutes the thermal circle and the rotation angles. Our equation asserts that the $\mathbb{Z}_{\kappa+1}$-invariant part of $\ln Z/\beta$ is a constant fixed by the a-anomaly. Our derivation assumes CP-invariance and locality of the thermal effective action, whose structure we constrain using an algebraic formalism starting from embedding space.
summary: CFT$_d$、$d = 2\kappa$ 的扭曲 $S^{d-1}\times S^1$ 配分函数的高温膨胀最近已被证明服从通用约束的无限塔。我们明确地确定了这些约束，并证明它们可以打包成一个涉及与 $\mathbb{Z}_{\kappa+1}$ 同构的大共形微分同胚的单个方程，该方程循环排列热圆和旋转角。我们的方程断言 $\ln Z/\beta$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_{\kappa+1}$ 不变部分是由 a 异常固定的常数。我们的推导假设了热有效作用的 CP 不变性和局部性，我们从嵌入空间开始使用代数形式来约束其结构。

title: An Exact QFT/Lattice Map for Fermions
abstract: We construct an exact map between continuum fermion fields and lattice fields in 1+1 dimensions. This map rewrites a continuum Hamiltonian as a lattice Hamiltonian with nearest-neighbor couplings and an infinite-dimensional local Hilbert space. The resulting lattice model reproduces exactly the energy spectrum, global operator algebra, chiral symmetries, and anomalies of the continuum QFT on any finite lattice. Unlike domain wall fermions, truncating the local Hilbert space introduces no extra massless modes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval converges as the truncation is removed. The lattice local algebras are of type I and lie between the type III continuum algebras of nested spatial regions, in accordance with the split property. We demonstrate this construction explicitly for $N$ Majorana fermions, realizing the $\mathrm{O}(N)_\mathrm{L}\times\mathrm{O}(N)_\mathrm{R}$ lattice chiral symmetry. We also construct an exact lattice model for the Schwinger model and numerically reproduce the mass gap $e/\sqrt{\pi}$.
summary: 我们在 1+1 维度上构建了连续费米子场和晶格场之间的精确映射。该映射将连续哈密顿量重写为具有最近邻耦合和无限维局部希尔伯特空间的格子哈密顿量。由此产生的晶格模型准确地再现了任何有限晶格上连续统 QFT 的能谱、全局算子代数、手征对称性和异常。与域壁费米子不同，截断局部希尔伯特空间不会引入额外的无质量模式，并且当截断被移除时，区间的纠缠熵会收敛。根据分裂性质，格局部代数属于 I 型，位于嵌套空间区域的 III 型连续统代数之间。我们明确地证明了 $N$ 马约拉纳费米子的这种构造，实现了 $\mathrm{O}(N)_\mathrm{L}\times\mathrm{O}(N)_\mathrm{R}$ 晶格手性对称性。我们还为施温格模型构建了精确的晶格模型，并以数值方式重现了质量间隙 $e/\sqrt{\pi}$。

title: Boundary $c\leq1$ Liouville CFT from the Bootstrap
abstract: We construct boundary Liouville conformal field theory at central charge $c\leq1$ with FZZT-type boundary conditions and show that it satisfies the Cardy--Lewellen sewing constraints on the disk and the annulus. Using the analytic bootstrap we derive the so far missing boundary three-point and bulk-to-boundary structure constants and a consistent disk one-point function as explicit meromorphic functions of the Liouville momenta. In sharp contrast to $c\geq25$, the open-string spectrum between two ``timelike'' FZZT boundaries is \emph{discrete}, yet non-trivially consistent through open-closed duality with the \emph{continuous} closed-string spectrum of Ribault and Santachiara.
summary: 我们用FZZT型边界条件构造了中心电荷$c\leq1$处的边界Liouville共形场理论，并证明它满足圆盘和环面的Cardy-Lewellen缝合约束。使用解析引导程序，我们推导出迄今为止缺失的边界三点和体到边界结构常数以及一致的盘单点函数作为刘维尔动量的显式亚纯函数。与 $c\geq25$ 形成鲜明对比的是，两个“类时”FZZT 边界之间的开弦谱是 \emph{离散}，但通过开闭对偶性与 Ribault 和 Santachiara 的 \emph{连续} 闭弦谱非平凡一致。

title: On the Geometric Structure of Hyperbolic Clifford Bundles and Associated Spin Groups
abstract: In this paper, we present the spinor structure associated with the Hyperbolic Clifford algebra of a real $n$-dimensional vector space $V$, which is denoted by $\mathcal{C}l\left(H_{V}\right)$. Unlike the standard Clifford algebra, the Hyperbolic Clifford algebra $\mathcal{C}l(H_V)$ simultaneously accommodates both multiforms and multivectors in a single algebraic structure, making it the natural framework---known as the ``mother algebra''---for the study of superfields in theoretical physics and for generalizing the Clifford bundle formalism to hyperbolic structures arising in gravitational theories. The orthogonal groups and orthogonal transformations associated to the hyperbolic space $H_{V}$ are presented. The Clifford--Lipschitz group and the Pin and Spin groups associated with $\mathcal{C}l\left(H_{V}\right)$ are defined. Then, the frame bundle and spinor structure associated to Hyperbolic Clifford algebra is derived.
summary: 在本文中，我们提出了与实$n$维向量空间$V$的双曲Clifford代数相关的旋量结构，用$\mathcal{C}l\left(H_{V}\right)$表示。与标准 Clifford 代数不同，双曲 Clifford 代数 $\mathcal{C}l(H_V)$ 同时在单个代数结构中容纳多种形式和多向量，使其成为研究理论物理中超场以及将 Clifford 丛形式推广到引力理论中出现的双曲结构的自然框架（称为“母代数”）。给出了与双曲空间 $H_{V}$ 相关的正交群和正交变换。定义了与 $\mathcal{C}l\left(H_{V}\right)$ 相关的 Clifford--Lipschitz 群以及 Pin 和 Spin 群。然后，推导了与双曲克利福德代数相关的框架丛和旋量结构。

title: A hybrid quantum-classical lattice kinetic scheme with tensor-train feedback for incompressible flows
abstract: Nonlinear lattice kinetic simulation requires each updated distribution to supply the velocity and gradients that determine the next step. In a quantum-classical solver, reading out the full distribution incurs work proportional to the lattice size. We construct a tensor-train (TT) interface that retains reusable classical cores at the physical amplitude scale for a full-relaxation lattice kinetic scheme. The cores supply nonlinear coefficients and prepare each quantum input. Energy-scaled propagation and coordinate recovery encode the updated distribution, and alternating least-squares reconstruction converts signed Hadamard-test overlaps into output cores by restoring a known normalization factor. The next step starts from accepted cores without replaying previous quantum evolution. Under positive, unit-sum reference coefficients, positive lower and finite upper density bounds, and Lipschitz equilibrium sensitivity, perturbation bounds relate local defects to feedback errors. Resource bounds account for classical operations, circuit execution, sampling, and verification. Classical diagnostics expose why distribution accuracy alone is insufficient: in 80-step feedback on a $16\times16$ grid, rank cap 4 nearly eliminates the vortex despite a final distribution error below $1\%$, whereas rank cap 12 gives relative velocity error $1.03\times10^{-3}$. Four-step binomial readout simulations show that tightening core sampling tolerance threefold raises the prescribed sufficient budget from $5.97\times10^{12}$ to $5.37\times10^{13}$ shots as the result approaches the fixed-rank, fixed-sweep exact-overlap trajectory. The interface therefore provides a way to connect quantum propagation to nonlinear feedback and to assess the separate demands of compression, velocity accuracy, and readout precision.
summary:
非线性晶格动力学模拟需要每个更新的分布提供确定下一步的速度和梯度。在量子经典求解器中，读出完整分布会产生与晶格尺寸成比例的功。我们构建了一个张量序列（TT）接口，该接口在物理振幅尺度上保留了可重复使用的经典核心，以实现全弛豫晶格动力学方案。核心提供非线性系数并准备每个量子输入。能量缩放传播和坐标恢复对更新的分布进行编码，并且交替最小二乘重建通过恢复已知的归一化因子将带符号的哈达玛测试重叠转换为输出核心。下一步从公认的核心开始，而不重演之前的量子演化。在正的单位和参考系数、正的密度下限和有限的上限以及利普希茨平衡灵敏度下，扰动界限将局部缺陷与反馈误差联系起来。资源边界考虑了经典操作、电路执行、采样和验证。

经典诊断揭示了为什么仅靠分布精度是不够的：在 $16\times16$ 网格上的 80 步反馈中，尽管最终分布误差低于 $1\%$，但排名上限 4 几乎消除了涡流，而排名上限 12 给出了相对速度误差 $1.03\times10^{-3}$。四步二项式读出模拟表明，当结果接近固定秩、固定扫描精确重叠轨迹时，收紧核心采样容差将规定的足够预算从 $5.97\times10^{12}$ 提高到 $5.37\times10^{13}$。因此，该接口提供了一种将量子传播与非线性反馈连接起来并评估压缩、速度精度和读出精度的单独需求的方法。

title: Eigenstates on $O^\ast$-algebras with an application to ladder operators
abstract: Following some recent results, we consider here a particular class of states on a $O^\ast$-algebra $\M$ which we call {\em eigenstates of an element} $A\in\M$, and we deduce some of their properties. Then, we apply our definition to a family of ladder elements, i.e. elements of $\M$ obeying certain algebraic (commutation) relations which are physically motivated, and we discuss several results for these states
summary: 根据最近的一些结果，我们在这里考虑 $O^\ast$-代数 $\M$ 上的一类特定状态，我们将其称为 {\em 元素的本征态} $A\in\M$，并推断出它们的一些属性。然后，我们将我们的定义应用于一系列梯子元素，即 $\M$ 的元素遵守某些物理动机的代数（交换）关系，并讨论这些状态的几个结果

title: An Excursion into Grassmannian Spectra
abstract: We revisit the classical spectral problem for the Laplace-Beltrami and Laplace-Bochner operators on complex Grassmannians. After reviewing the standard approach based on non-commutative harmonic analysis, we develop two complementary methods originating from the quantization of the corresponding one-dimensional sigma model, both with and without a magnetic monopole field. The first is based on $\mathbf{SU}(n)$-equivariant first-order GLSM formulation and gives explicit eigenfunctions in terms of projectors and Plücker coordinates. The second uses a spin-chain realization of free particles on manifolds and describes the space of square-integrable functions, or sections in the magnetic case, through limiting tensor products of long rectangular $\mathbf{SU}(n)$ representations. Together, these approaches provide a more explicit picture of the spectral geometry of Grassmannians and clarify the relation between harmonics, Young diagrams, magnetic bundles, and Laplacian spectra.
summary: 我们重新审视复杂格拉斯曼算子的拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米和拉普拉斯-博赫纳算子的经典谱问题。在回顾了基于非交换调和分析的标准方法之后，我们开发了两种源自相应一维西格玛模型量化的互补方法，无论有或没有磁单极场。第一个基于 $\mathbf{SU}(n)$ 等变一阶 GLSM 公式，并根据投影仪和普吕克坐标给出显式特征函数。第二个使用流形上自由粒子的自旋链实现，并通过长矩形 $\mathbf{SU}(n)$ 表示的限制张量积来描述平方可积函数的空间或磁性情况下的截面。这些方法共同提供了格拉斯曼光谱几何的更清晰图像，并阐明了谐波、杨氏图、磁束和拉普拉斯光谱之间的关系。

title: Lorentz-Invariant Measure for Path Integrals in the Future Cone
abstract: We construct a measure on continuous paths in the future cone of two-dimensional space that is invariant under the orthochronous Lorentz group and quasi-invariant under the action of the diffeomorphism group. We use the proposed measure to obtain the fundamental solution of the heat equation. The result agrees with the expression obtained by other methods.
summary: 我们构造了二维空间未来锥中连续路径的测度，该测度在正交洛伦兹群下是不变的，在微分同胚群的作用下是准不变的。我们使用所提出的方法来获得热方程的基本解。该结果与其他方法得到的表达式一致。

title: An exact unstable mode of self-similar Yang--Mills solutionsin 5+1 dimensions
abstract: Self-similar solutions play an important role in the formation of singularities in the Yang--Mills equations. In five space dimensions, these equations admit infinitely many self-similar solutions with an increasing number of unstable modes. It was observed numerically that all excited profiles share the least unstable eigenvalue $\lambda=5$. We explain this remarkable spectral property by an elementary construction of the corresponding eigenfunction in terms of the profile.
summary: 自相似解在杨-米尔斯方程中奇点的形成中起着重要作用。在五个空间维度中，这些方程允许无限多个自相似解，并且不稳定模式的数量不断增加。通过数值观察发现，所有激发轮廓都具有最不稳定的特征值 $\lambda=5$。我们通过轮廓方面相应本征函数的基本构造来解释这种显着的光谱特性。

title: Multiplicity and parity in Hirota's $N$-soliton conditions: the bilinear families $L\,(D_x^{3}+Λ)^{2n+1}$
abstract: Hirota's three-soliton condition is the standard test for the integrability of a bilinear equation $P(D)f\cdot f=0$, and the folklore implication ``three-soliton condition $\Rightarrow$ $N$-soliton solutions for all $N$'' underlies the classifications of Hietarinta. We study this implication in two directions. The first is the family $L\,(D_x^3+\Lambda)^{2n+1}f\cdot f=0$ with $L$, $\Lambda$ linear forms in the Hirota operators, which for $n=0$ contains the Korteweg--de Vries, Ito and Boiti--Leon--Manna--Pempinelli equations and for $L=D_x$ is the family of Gürses and Pekcan. On the principal component of the dispersion variety the $N$-soliton condition reduces to a sign sum of two bialternants; counting odd exponents shows that for $n=0$ the class is Hirota integrable and that for $n\ge1$ the three-soliton condition holds for every $L$, and an explicit formula for the four-soliton residual proves the Gürses--Pekcan conjecture that the four-soliton condition fails for every $n\ge1$. The formula yields sum-of-squares certificates excluding four-soliton solutions at every real configuration for the Gürses--Pekcan and Ito equations, classifies the real members of the class, and determines maximal numbers of nondegenerate solitons: exactly four or five for $n=1$ according as $L$ lies in the span of $D_x,\Lambda$ or not, five for $n=2$ and $L=D_x$, and finite for every $n\ge1$ and every $L$. The second direction is a reformulation of the implication for a single non-hyperplane component of multiplicity one, which we prove, with complete classifications, for all graph-type dispersions $L(q(D)+D_t)$, for every irreducible even quadric component in any dimension and with an arbitrary cofactor, for parabolic components, for the dispersions $F(\ell)+Q$ containing the Kadomtsev--Petviashvili surface, and, with a prescribed one-parameter phase family, for the cubic graph.
summary:
Hirota 的三孤子条件是双线性方程 $P(D)f\cdot f=0$ 可积性的标准检验，民间传说“所有 $N$ 的三孤子条件 $\Rightarrow$ $N$-孤子解”是 Hietarinta 分类的基础。我们从两个方向研究这一含义。第一个是 Hirota 算子中的 $L\,(D_x^3+\Lambda)^{2n+1}f\cdot f=0$ 族，其中 $L$, $\Lambda$ 线性形式，对于 $n=0$ 包含 Korteweg--de Vries、Ito 和 Boiti--Leon--Manna--Pempinelli 方程组，对于 $L=D_x$ 是 Gürses 和 Pekcan 族。在色散品种的主成分上，$N$-孤子条件简化为两个双交替项的符号和；计算奇数指数表明，对于 $n=0$，该类是 Hirota 可积的，并且对于 $n\ge1$，三孤子条件对于每个 $L$ 都成立，并且四孤子残差的显式公式证明了 Gürses-Pekcan 猜想，即对于每个 $n\ge1$，四孤子条件都失败。

该公式生成平方和证书，排除 Gürses-Pekcan 和 Ito 方程的每个实数配置的四个孤子解，对类的实数成员进行分类，并确定非简并孤子的最大数量：根据 $L$ 是否位于 $D_x、\Lambda$ 的范围内，$n=1$ 正好为四个或五个，对于 $n=2$ 和 $L=D_x$ 为五个，并且对于每个都是有限的$n\ge1$ 和每个 $L$。第二个方向是重新表述多重性一的单个非超平面分量的含义，我们通过完整的分类来证明，对于所有图型色散 $L(q(D)+D_t)$，对于任何维度中的每个不可约偶二次分量并具有任意辅因子，对于抛物线分量，对于包含 Kadomtsev--Petviashvili 表面的色散 $F(\ell)+Q$，并且具有规定的单参数相族，三次图。

title: High-order compact ALE gas-kinetic scheme on three-dimensional unstructured meshes
abstract: In this paper, a compact high-order gas-kinetic scheme (HGKS) is developed for compressible arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) computations on three-dimensional unstructured meshes. To achieve high-order spatial accuracy, a large number of matrix inversions are required for spatial reconstruction. In ALE computations, the mesh moves and the geometric information must be recalculated at each time step, which reduces computational efficiency. To improve efficiency, a memory-reduction reconstruction strategy is employed to construct a quadratic polynomial on unstructured meshes. By differentiating the candidate polynomial, the quadratic terms are obtained by the least-squares method using the average gradient values of the cell itself and its neighboring cells. The linear terms of the polynomial are also determined by the least-squares method. On three-dimensional unstructured meshes, a $3\times3$ coefficient matrix must be stored, and four least-squares procedures are required to construct a quadratic polynomial. To suppress numerical oscillations in flows with discontinuities, generalized essentially non-oscillatory (GENO) reconstruction and a gradient compression factor are adopted. To accelerate the computation, a multi-GPU accelerated code is implemented using Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) and Message Passing Interface (MPI). The current scheme is fully explicit, and the acceleration framework can be developed based on cell-level parallelism. Numerical examples are presented to evaluate the accuracy and robustness of the scheme, including flows with strong discontinuities, pitching wings, and helicopter rotors. Numerical results confirm the excellent performance of the compact ALE scheme on unstructured meshes.
summary:
在本文中，开发了一种紧凑的高阶气体动力学方案（HGKS），用于三维非结构化网格上的可压缩任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）计算。为了实现高阶空间精度，需要大量的矩阵求逆来进行空间重建。在 ALE 计算中，网格会移动，并且必须在每个时间步重新计算几何信息，这降低了计算效率。为了提高效率，采用内存减少重建策略在非结构化网格上构造二次多项式。通过对候选多项式求导，利用单元格本身及其相邻单元格的平均梯度值，通过最小二乘法获得二次项。多项式的线性项也由最小二乘法确定。在三维非结构化网格上，必须存储 $3\times3$ 系数矩阵，并且需要四个最小二乘过程来构造二次多项式。

为了抑制不连续流动中的数值振荡，采用广义本质非振荡（GENO）重建和梯度压缩因子。为了加速计算，使用统一计算设备架构 (CUDA) 和消息传递接口 (MPI) 实现多 GPU 加速代码。目前的方案是完全明确的，并且可以基于单元级并行性来开发加速框架。给出了数值例子来评估该方案的准确性和鲁棒性，包括具有强不连续性的流动、俯仰机翼和直升机旋翼。数值结果证实了紧凑 ALE 方案在非结构化网格上的优异性能。

title: Rasterization-based discontinuous integration on the GPU
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method based on rasterization in computer graphics for the integration of discontinuous functions accurately and efficiently on the GPU. The proposed method takes advantage of the massively parallel architecture of GPUs via a modified graphics pipeline, where discontinuities are encoded through geometric primitives and processed in the rasterization stage, and multisample anti-aliasing (MSAA) is used to improve integration accuracy across subdomain interfaces. We present both hardware- and software-based pipelines and compare their performance in terms of accuracy as well as computational effort on modern GPU hardware with adaptive quadrature on the CPU. For the tested hardware, at approximately comparable median relative error, the hardware pipeline is up to around $100\text{x}$ faster than adaptive quadrature, while the single- and double-precision software pipelines achieve up to $840\text{x}$ and $1200\text{x}$ speedups compared to their adaptive quadrature counterparts. We use the finite cell method as model problem, where cutcells represent discontinuous integrands at the interface of the physical and fictitious domains and demonstrate the performance of the proposed method using numerical benchmarks. The end-to-end finite cell solution runtime is reduced by a factor of $8.3$ to $9.5$ in the single-precision pipeline and by a factor of $62$ to $72$ in the double-precision pipeline at the prescribed integration settings. Therefore, results indicate that the rasterization-based integration method is a promising alternative for the accurate and efficient integration of discontinuous functions in demanding applications on the GPU.
summary:
在本文中，我们提出了一种基于计算机图形学光栅化的方法，用于在 GPU 上准确有效地集成不连续函数。该方法通过改进的图形管道利用 GPU 的大规模并行架构，其中通过几何图元对不连续性进行编码并在光栅化阶段进行处理，并使用多重采样抗锯齿 (MSAA) 来提高跨子域接口的集成精度。我们展示了基于硬件和软件的管道，并比较了它们在现代 GPU 硬件上与 CPU 上的自适应正交上的精度和计算量方面的性能。对于所测试的硬件，在大约可比的中值相对误差下，硬件管道比自适应正交快约 $100\text{x}$，而单精度和双精度软件管道与自适应正交同行相比可实现高达 $840\text{x}$ 和 $1200\text{x}$ 的加速。

我们使用有限单元方法作为模型问题，其中 cutcell 表示物理域和虚拟域界面处的不连续被积函数，并使用数值基准演示所提出方法的性能。在规定的集成设置下，单精度管道中的端到端有限单元解决方案运行时间减少了 8.3 美元至 9.5 美元，双精度管道中的端到端有限单元解决方案运行时间减少了 62 美元至 72 美元。因此，结果表明，基于光栅化的积分方法是在 GPU 上要求较高的应用中准确、高效地积分不连续函数的有前途的替代方法。

title: Non-local approximations for the Schrödinger operator with a general point interaction via the non-relativistic limit
abstract: We consider the one-dimensional Dirac operator $D_{A,c}$ with a general, not necessarily self-adjoint, point interaction at the origin, whose strength is described by an arbitrary complex $2\times 2$ matrix $A$ and suitably rescaled by the speed of light $c$, together with its non-local approximations $D_{A,c}^{\epsilon}$ obtained by replacing the Dirac distribution by a rank-one projection onto a scaled function $v_\epsilon$. It is known that $D_{A,c}^\epsilon \to D_{A,c}$ as $\epsilon\to 0+$ and that $D_{A,c}-c^2/2$ converges, as $c\to+\infty$, to the Schrödinger operator $H_A$ with the general point interaction, both in the norm resolvent sense. We prove that the first convergence is uniform with respect to $c$ in a neighbourhood of $+\infty$, and we provide explicit rates of convergence. Combining this with an explicit computation of the non-relativistic limit of $D_{A,c}^\epsilon$ for fixed $\epsilon$, we show that the two limits can be interchanged and that the corresponding double limit exists. As a by-product we obtain a family of non-local, rank-two approximations $H_A^\epsilon$ of $H_A$ that converge to $H_A$ in the norm resolvent sense. Contrary to the relativistic setting, the coupling constants of $H_A^\epsilon$ are renormalized; we give an explicit formula for this renormalization.
summary:
