我们考虑一维狄拉克算子 $D_{A,c}$ 在原点处具有一般的、不一定是自伴的点相互作用，其强度由任意复数 $2\times 2$ 矩阵 $A$ 描述，并通过光速 $c$ 进行适当重新缩放，以及通过将狄拉克分布替换为缩放函数的一阶投影而获得的非局部近似值 $D_{A,c}^{\epsilon}$ $v_\epsilon$。已知 $D_{A,c}^\epsilon \to D_{A,c}$ 为 $\epsilon\to 0+$，$D_{A,c}-c^2/2$ 收敛为 $c\to+\infty$，具有一般点相互作用的薛定谔算子 $H_A$，两者都在范数解析意义上。我们证明，在 $+\infty$ 邻域中，第一次收敛相对于 $c$ 是一致的，并且我们提供了显式的收敛速率。将此与固定 $\epsilon$ 的 $D_{A,c}^\epsilon$ 的非相对论极限的显式计算相结合，我们表明这两个极限可以互换，并且存在相应的双重极限。作为副产品，我们获得了一系列非局部的、$H_A$ 的二阶近似值 $H_A^\epsilon$，它们在范数解析意义上收敛到 $H_A$。

与相对论设置相反，$H_A^\epsilon$ 的耦合常数被重新归一化；我们给出了这种重整化的明确公式。

title: Dynamical Properties of the Multiple Elastic Pendulum
abstract: This article studies the dynamical properties of the multiple elastic pendulum formed by an arbitrary number of point masses connected in a chain by elastic springs. First, using the Lagrangian formulation, the equations of motion governing the system's behavior, accounting for both large-angle displacements and elastic deformations, are derived. It is shown that well-established, low-dimensional systems, such as the classical double elastic pendulum, can be systematically recovered as particular cases directly from the general equations of motion after applying the appropriates particular conditions. The behavior of the system under small oscillations near its stable equilibrium is also investigated. For this case, the linearized equations allow the solution of the eigenvalue problem, demonstrating that in this case uncoupled behavior between the angular displacements and the spring elongations.
summary: 本文研究了由任意数量的点质量通过弹性弹簧连接成链形成的多弹性摆的动力学特性。首先，使用拉格朗日公式，推导了控制系统行为的运动方程，同时考虑了大角度位移和弹性变形。结果表明，在应用适当的特定条件后，成熟的低维系统（例如经典双弹性摆）可以直接从一般运动方程系统地恢复为特定情况。还研究了系统在稳定平衡附近的小振荡下的行为。对于这种情况，线性化方程可以解决特征值问题，证明在这种情况下角位移和弹簧伸长之间存在非耦合行为。

title: Long-range entangled criticality from coherent errors
abstract: We find that coherent error can induce a phase transition from the clean surface code phase into an extended long-range entangled critical regime with diverging Markov length. To demonstrate this, we establish two general results of independent interest. The first relates topology and quantum information to mixed-state entanglement: we show that when a noise channel acting on a topological code preserves a higher-form symmetry and nonzero coherent information, the noisy state for generic logical input is long-range entangled. The second generalizes the local recovery construction based on finite Markov length to any locally parameterized family, thus encompassing local Lindbladian evolution, coherent errors followed by syndrome dephasing, and thermal states. We apply these results to the honeycomb surface code, in which we find an extended long-range entangled critical regime that is a quasi-long-ranged counterpart of 1-form strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. As a byproduct of these studies, we relate the conditional mutual information to conductance in a Majorana network model.
summary: 我们发现相干误差可以引起从干净表面码相到具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展长程纠缠临界状态的相变。为了证明这一点，我们建立了两个独立利益的一般结果。第一个将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠相关：我们证明，当作用于拓扑代码的噪声通道保留更高形式的对称性和非零相干信息时，通用逻辑输入的噪声状态是长程纠缠。第二个将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任何局部参数化族，从而涵盖局部 Lindbladian 演化、伴随相位差的相干误差和热状态。我们将这些结果应用于蜂窝表面代码，其中我们发现了一个扩展的长程纠缠临界状态，它是 1-形式强到弱自发对称性破缺的准长程对应体。作为这些研究的副产品，我们将条件互信息与马约拉纳网络模型中的电导联系起来。

title: Entanglement-Aware Quantum Circuit Optimization through Globally Optimal Partitioning
abstract: We introduce a scalable framework for globally optimal quantum-circuit partitioning and entanglement-aware block resynthesis. The partitioning problem is formulated as an integer linear program over qubit-feasible convex subcircuits, supporting objectives such as minimizing the number of partitions or a weighted execution cost. The resulting partition selection is exact over the enumerated feasible candidates and their computed costs when the ILP is solved to proven optimality. The selected partitions are resynthesized using an operator-Schmidt rank (OSR) based synthesis technique, which exploits their internal entanglement structure. We compare the end-to-end integer linear programming (ILP)--OSR workflow with BQSKit while identifying their different routing methods, and separately compare local OSR and BQSKit synthesis on matched three- and four-qubit unitaries. On the frozen sample of 772 local unitary targets, OSR produces 741 verified syntheses versus 617 for BQSKit, and matches or improves the CNOT count in all 617 jointly verified pairs. These results demonstrate that globally optimal partition selection combined with entanglement-aware resynthesis improves circuit quality and extends block-based optimization to problem sizes that are impractical for existing optimization workflows.
summary:
我们引入了一个可扩展的框架，用于全局最优的量子电路划分和纠缠感知块再合成。分区问题被表述为量子位可行的凸子电路上的整数线性程序，支持诸如最小化分区数量或加权执行成本等目标。当 ILP 被求解为经过证明的最优性时，所得到的分区选择对于枚举的可行候选及其计算成本是准确的。使用基于算子施密特等级（OSR）的合成技术重新合成选定的分区，该技术利用了它们的内部纠缠结构。我们将端到端整数线性规划 (ILP)-OSR 工作流程与 BQSKit 进行比较，同时确定它们不同的路由方法，并分别比较匹配的三量子位酉和四量子位酉上的本地 OSR 和 BQSKit 合成。在 772 个局部单一目标的冻结样本上，OSR 生成 741 个经过验证的合成，而 BQSKit 为 617 个，并且匹配或改进了所有 617 个联合验证对中的 CNOT 计数。

这些结果表明，全局最优分区选择与纠缠感知再合成相结合可以提高电路质量，并将基于块的优化扩展到现有优化工作流程不切实际的问题规模。

title: High-fidelity quantum gate learning via physics-informed neural networks
abstract: We propose a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach for high-fidelity quantum gate learning in both one- and two-qubit systems. We train a PINN using the time-dependent Schrödinger equation, where smooth control fields with fixed boundary conditions are obtained by minimizing a loss function that considers model dynamics, gate error, physical constraints, regularization terms, and multiple initial conditions. Training considers pairs of mutually unbiased bases, while independent validation combines Haar-random input states with the average gate fidelity. Unitary simulations yield an average gate infidelity of $8.49\times10^{-8}$ for Hadamard and values between $3.39\times10^{-7}$ and $4.96\times10^{-6}$ for controlled-NOT under $XX$, $YY$, and $ZZ$ interactions. We examine how the learned control fields depend on the coupling, training configuration, and available local fields, including five exchange-type dipolar scenarios. We test the learned control fields under the Lindblad master equation with dephasing and amplitude damping, theoretically reproducing the expected first-order fidelity loss in the weak-dissipation regime. Finally, boundary-adapted Chebyshev expansions represent 139 learned controls with a minimum common count of $K_\ast=24$ coefficients per control for all eleven family-averaged mean squared errors to fall below $10^{-6}$. Separately, square-pulse and Strang propagation at $K=30$ preserve all 31 continuous polynomial references within infidelity $10^{-5}$ at $N=128$ and all larger tested resolutions, under both sampling rules. These results connect multi-state gate synthesis, control-resource characterization, and compact square-pulse playback.
summary:
我们提出了一种物理信息神经网络（PINN）方法，用于单量子位和双量子位系统中的高保真量子门学习。我们使用瞬态薛定谔方程训练 PINN，其中通过最小化考虑模型动力学、门误差、物理约束、正则化项和多个初始条件的损失函数来获得具有固定边界条件的平滑控制场。训练考虑相互无偏的基对，而独立验证则将 Haar 随机输入状态与平均门保真度结合起来。酉模拟对于 Hadamard 产生的平均门不忠度为 $8.49\times10^{-8}$，对于 $XX$、$YY$ 和 $ZZ$ 交互作用下的受控非，值介于 $3.39\times10^{-7}$ 和 $4.96\times10^{-6}$ 之间。我们研究了学习的控制场如何依赖于耦合、训练配置和可用的局部场，包括五种交换型偶极场景。我们在具有相移和振幅阻尼的 Lindblad 主方程下测试学习的控制场，理论上再现了弱耗散区域中预期的一阶保真度损失。

最后，边界适应切比雪夫展开表示 139 个学习控制，每个控制的最小公共计数为 $K_\ast=24$ 系数，使所有 11 个家庭平均均方误差降至 $10^{-6}$ 以下。另外，在两种采样规则下，$K=30$ 处的方波脉冲和 Strang 传播保留了 $N=128$ 处不忠度 $10^{-5}$ 内的所有 31 个连续多项式参考以及所有更大的测试分辨率。这些结果将多状态门综合、控制资源表征和紧凑方脉冲回放联系起来。

title: Unital qubit channels are $3$-noisy
abstract: The algebraic and environmental characteristics of mixed unitary quantum operations are investigated. It is established that the composition of two uniformly n-mixed unitary channels is itself n-noisy, and this n-noisy property is shown to be an invariant under unitary equivalence. Furthermore, by utilizing majorization and the divisibility of Kraus rank-four unital qubit channels, we demonstrate that any unital qubit channel can be physically simulated using a three-dimensional maximally mixed environment. Together, these results advance the classification and physical realization of noisy quantum channels.
summary: 研究了混合酉量子运算的代数和环境特性。确定两个均匀 n 混合酉通道的组合本身就是 n 噪声，并且这种 n 噪声特性在酉等价下被证明是不变量。此外，通过利用克劳斯四阶单位量子位通道的主化和可分性，我们证明任何单位量子位通道都可以使用三维最大混合环境进行物理模拟。这些结果共同推进了噪声量子通道的分类和物理实现。

title: Non-Hermitian effective dynamics from post-selection protocols
abstract: Multiple seemingly distinct frameworks are commonly proposed to explain the emergence of effective non-Hermitian dynamics in quantum systems coupled to an environment. Furthermore, it remains contested how to properly calculate expectation values or whether thermal equilibrium states exist in non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we show that Feshbach projection, the Lindblad master equation, and the ancilla approach can all be understood through the Kraus map formalism, leading to non-Hermitian time evolution if an appropriate post-selection procedure is enforced. After first deriving an exact expression for the conditional system dynamics, we discuss the approximations employed in each approach and the classes of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that can be obtained. Within this framework, we physically justify the consistency of the right-right formalism (as opposed to the biorthogonal one) for calculating expectation values. Finally, we demonstrate that the traditional notion of thermodynamic equilibrium is not applicable to general non-Hermitian systems. Consequently, stationary states are characterized as non-equilibrium steady states, which should not be conflated with system-projected thermal states of the system-environment composite.
summary:
通常提出多个看似不同的框架来解释与环境耦合的量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的出现。此外，如何正确计算期望值或非厄米系统中是否存在热平衡状态仍然存在争议。在这项工作中，我们表明 Feshbach 投影、Lindblad 主方程和辅助方法都可以通过 Kraus 映射形式主义来理解，如果执行适当的后选择程序，则会导致非厄米时间演化。在首先推导出条件系统动力学的精确表达式之后，我们讨论了每种方法中采用的近似以及可以获得的非厄米哈密顿量的类别。在此框架内，我们从物理上证明了用于计算期望值的右-右形式主义（与双正交形式主义相对）的一致性。最后，我们证明传统的热力学平衡概念不适用于一般的非厄米系统。

因此，静止状态被表征为非平衡稳态，不应将其与系统-环境复合材料的系统预测热状态混为一谈。

title: Adaptive Qubit Encoding for Continuous-Variable Quantum Optimization
abstract: Optimizing continuous-variable functions on qubit-based quantum hardware requires a finite representation of the search space and a solver-compatible representation of the objective function. Fixed-grid discretizations provide a direct encoding, but restrict the search to a predefined range and resolution; at the same time, constructing a compact Hamiltonian for a general continuous-variable objective can be impractical. Here, we introduce a framework for continuous-variable optimization tailored to qubit-based quantum architectures. The method combines an adaptive discretization with an iterative local mapping of the objective function onto an effective spin-glass Hamiltonian. We assess the approach on unconstrained and constrained instances of the $n$-dimensional Gramacy-Lee benchmark, and on a proof-of-concept inverse-planning problem in intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) for cancer treatment. The results show that this framework can produce competitive solutions, supporting its use as a flexible mapping strategy for continuous-variable optimization in qubit-based quantum and quantum-inspired pipelines.
summary: 在基于量子位的量子硬件上优化连续变量函数需要搜索空间的有限表示和目标函数的求解器兼容表示。固定网格离散化提供了直接编码，但将搜索限制在预定义的范围和分辨率内；同时，为一般的连续变量目标构建紧凑的哈密顿量可能是不切实际的。在这里，我们介绍了一个针对基于量子位的量子架构量身定制的连续变量优化框架。该方法将自适应离散化与目标函数到有效自旋玻璃哈密顿量的迭代局部映射相结合。我们评估了 $n$ 维 Gramacy-Lee 基准的无约束和约束实例以及癌症治疗调强放射治疗 (IMRT) 中的概念验证逆向规划问题的方法。结果表明，该框架可以产生有竞争力的解决方案，支持其用作基于量子位的量子和量子启发管道中的连续变量优化的灵活映射策略。

title: Tight Quasiprobabilistic Entropic Uncertainty Relations for Discrete Quantum Systems
abstract: It was conjectured by Wehrl and proven by Lieb that the Shannon differential entropy of the Husimi function of a continuous-variable quantum state is lower bounded by the value it takes on coherent states. This corroborates the intuition, familiar from Heisenberg's uncertainty relations, that coherent states are minimal uncertainty states. The analogous statement for the Wigner function would be that the Wigner differential entropy of states with a positive Wigner function is bounded below by the entropy of pure Gaussian states. This was conjectured a decade ago, but recently disproven. Here, we prove the analogous statement for Kirkwood-Dirac distributions with mutually unbiased bases and for the Gross-Wigner distributions. For these discrete systems, the entropy-minimizing role is played by the pure states with positive quasiprobability distributions. Further, we prove that Kirkwood-Dirac distributions with large nonpositivity have large uncertainty.
summary: 由 Wehrl 猜想并由 Lieb 证明，连续变量量子态的 Husimi 函数的香农微分熵的下界是它在相干态上所取的值。这证实了海森堡不确定性关系中熟悉的直觉，即相干态是最小不确定性状态。维格纳函数的类似陈述是，具有正维格纳函数的状态的维格纳微分熵受纯高斯状态的熵的限制。这是十年前的猜想，但最近被证实了。在这里，我们证明了具有相互无偏基的柯克伍德-狄拉克分布和格罗斯-维格纳分布的类似陈述。对于这些离散系统，熵最小化的作用是由具有正准概率分布的纯态发挥的。此外，我们证明具有较大非正性的柯克伍德-狄拉克分布具有较大的不确定性。

title: Gaussian Quantum Integrated Sensing and Communication
abstract: We consider a quantum integrated sensing and communication problem over an optical link in which a low-power transmitter simultaneously communicates with a receiver and identifies the range of a defect producing a backscattered signal. We model the system as a lossy thermal-noise bosonic channel, in which the target, modeled as a beamsplitter, affects the timing of the backscattered signal through its location. Motivated by the envisioned deployment of entanglement-enabled quantum networks, we develop two protocols that allow the transmitter to leverage shared Gaussian entanglement, in the form of independent two-mode squeezed vacuum states or coupled three-mode squeezed vacuum states, to assist both sensing and communication. Since entanglement is known to enhance sensing, as demonstrated in quantum illumination, and to increase communication rates through entanglement-assisted communication, the transmitter faces a trade-off in allocating its entanglement resources between the two tasks. Our main results characterize these trade-offs under the proposed protocols in terms of achievable communication rate/sensing error-exponent regions, which outperform time-sharing schemes and demonstrate a quantum advantage.
summary:
我们考虑光链路上的量子集成传感和通信问题，其中低功率发射器同时与接收器通信并识别产生反向散射信号的缺陷范围。我们将系统建模为有损热噪声玻色子通道，其中建模为分束器的目标通过其位置影响反向散射信号的时序。受纠缠量子网络部署设想的推动，我们开发了两种协议，允许发射器利用共享高斯纠缠，以独立的二模压缩真空态或耦合三模压缩真空态的形式，以协助传感和通信。由于众所周知，纠缠可以增强传感（如量子照明中所证明的那样），并通过纠缠辅助通信来提高通信速率，因此发射器在两个任务之间分配纠缠资源时面临着权衡。

我们的主要结果描述了所提出的协议在可实现的通信速率/传感误差指数区域方面的权衡，其性能优于分时方案并展示了量子优势。

title: Runtime Compilation for Quantum Circuits with PQF-Enabled $R_z$ Synthesis
abstract: In Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing (FTQC) using surface codes, reducing $T$-count is critical for efficient computation due to the high cost of $T$-state distillation. Probabilistic Quantum Circuit with Fallback (PQF) synthesis significantly lowers $T$-counts compared to standard protocols like Gridsynth, but introduces high circuit dynamism through extra gates inserted at runtime. This dynamism invalidates static compile-time routing, as these new $T$ gates require dynamic lattice surgery routing to establish non-intersecting ancilla paths to $T$-state factories while minimizing total execution time. To address this, we introduce $\text{R}^2$-PQF, a Runtime Routing protocol for PQF-synthesized quantum circuits. $\text{R}^2$-PQF dynamically routes gates layer-by-layer, computing paths during the execution of the previous logical timestep. To satisfy the strict computational window of $\sim t_{lattice\_surgery} + t_{reaction}$ and non-intersectionality constraints, we implement a Wavefront Breadth-First Search (W-BFS) and synthesise it on a 500MHz FPGA and 2 GHz ASIC. For a clock cycle of 2GHz, we achieve a median logical time-step of $1.51 \mu s$ for a 300 qubit Ising Hamiltonian circuit, demonstrating that $\text{R}^2$-PQF successfully resolves the vast majority of paths (with rare exceptions) within the execution window and enables the $T$-count benefits of PQF without latency penalties. Compared to a baseline stalling-based solution (the only no-runtime-recomputation solution), $\text{R}^2$-PQF speeds up circuit execution by $1.34\times$ on average and up to $1.76 \times$.
summary:
在使用表面代码的容错量子计算 (FTQC) 中，由于 $T$ 状态蒸馏的成本很高，因此减少 $T$ 计数对于高效计算至关重要。与 Gridsynth 等标准协议相比，具有回退 (PQF) 合成的概率量子电路显着降低了 $T$ 计数，但通过在运行时插入的额外门引入了高电路动态。这种动态性使静态编译时路由失效，因为这些新的 $T$ 门需要动态晶格手术路由来建立到 $T$ 状态工厂的非相交辅助路径，同时最大限度地减少总执行时间。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 $\text{R}^2$-PQF，这是一种用于 PQF 合成量子电路的运行时路由协议。 $\text{R}^2$-PQF 动态地逐层路由门，在上一个逻辑时间步执行期间计算路径。为了满足 $\sim t_{lattice\_surgery} + t_{reaction}$ 的严格计算窗口和非交叉性约束，我们实现了波前宽度优先搜索（W-BFS）并在 500MHz FPGA 和 2 GHz ASIC 上综合它。

对于 2GHz 的时钟周期，我们在 300 量子位伊辛哈密顿电路中实现了 $1.51 \mu s$ 的中位逻辑时间步，证明 $\text{R}^2$-PQF 成功解析了执行窗口内的绝大多数路径（极少数例外），并实现了 PQF 的 $T$ 计数优势，而没有延迟损失。与基于基线停顿的解决方案（唯一无需运行时重新计算的解决方案）相比，$\text{R}^2$-PQF 将电路执行速度平均提高了 $1.34\times$，最高可达 $1.76 \times$。

title: Entanglement Allocation for Quantum Integrated Sensing and Communication
abstract: Jointly supporting communication and distributed sensing over a shared, limited pool of entanglement resources is an attractive prospect for future quantum networks. We develop a network-level quantum integrated sensing and communication (Q-ISAC) framework in which a quantum base station dynamically allocates elementary Bell pairs between communication users and distributed sensing. Sensing resources are adaptively partitioned among multiple GHZ probes with dynamically selected sizes and sensing-node assignments. We derive an effective quantum Fisher information model accounting for probabilistic fusion, transmission loss, and memory decoherence, and formulate a finite-horizon allocation problem subject to communication QoS, expected sensing-information, sensing-reliability, and hardware constraints. A hierarchical constrained proximal policy optimization (HC-PPO) framework combines learned discrete sensing allocation with analytical continuous communication allocation. Numerical results show that GHZ probing requires approximately $27$--30% fewer sensing qubits than separable probing under modest probe-size caps and 65-67% fewer at the highest considered target under the same sensing requirements. Adaptive multi-GHZ partitioning provides greater robustness than single-GHZ sensing, while adaptive communication--sensing sharing outperforms the evaluated fixed splits. The proposed HC-PPO framework satisfies the joint requirements in at least 99.9% of test instances across the considered sensing targets and fusion probabilities. Monte Carlo evaluation separately shows that realized terminal information reached its target in 96-98% of realizations, distinguishing expected-information satisfaction from realized sensing performance.
summary:
在共享的、有限的纠缠资源池上联合支持通信和分布式传感是未来量子网络的一个有吸引力的前景。我们开发了一个网络级量子集成传感和通信（Q-ISAC）框架，其中量子基站在通信用户和分布式传感之间动态分配基本贝尔对。传感资源在多个 GHZ 探头之间自适应分配，并动态选择大小和传感节点分配。我们推导了一个有效的量子费希尔信息模型，该模型考虑了概率融合、传输损耗和内存退相干，并制定了受通信服务质量、预期传感信息、传感可靠性和硬件约束影响的有限范围分配问题。分层约束近端策略优化（HC-PPO）框架将学习的离散传感分配与分析的连续通信分配相结合。

数值结果表明，在适度的探针尺寸上限下，GHZ 探测所需的传感量子位比可分离探测少约 27--30%，在相同传感要求下，在最高考虑目标下需要的传感量子位少 65-67%。自适应多 GHZ 分区比单 GHZ 感测提供了更高的鲁棒性，而自适应通信感测共享优于评估的固定分割。所提出的 HC-PPO 框架在所考虑的传感目标和融合概率中满足至少 99.9% 的测试实例的联合要求。蒙特卡罗评估分别表明，实现的终端信息在 96-98% 的实现中达到了目标，区分了预期信息满意度和实现的感知性能。

title: Initialization-controlled fault sensitivity and force-balance plateaus in noisy variational quantum optimization
abstract: We study deep variational circuits for a periodic Heisenberg chain under local gate depolarization, at depths where noiseless training is coherently exact. Full-width initializations reach low coherent error faster than circuits with confined transverse generators, but incur a larger noise shift and need an order of magnitude more updates for noisy convergence. In many-body-localization-inspired initialization, bounding the initial transverse generator amplitudes keeps the operator support localized and suffices for low-fragility optimization, so longitudinal disorder and Floquet layer repetition are unnecessary. The fault-erasure fraction, the mean fraction of coherent energy removed per fault, sets the effective visibility through a parameter-free exponential model. Full-width circuits start with delocalized operator support, and once coherent energy builds up, each fault erases nearly all of it. Initially, their noise-induced gradient almost uniformly attenuates the coherent gradient, so coherent descent proceeds at the noiseless rate. They then stall on a high-noise force-balance plateau, where finite coherent and noise-induced gradients cancel to first order. At late times all initializations reach the same fault-erasure fraction and noisy-error band, but operator support contracts more slowly, at a rate set by the plateau residence time.
summary:
我们研究局栅去极化下周期性海森堡链的深度变分电路，在无噪声训练一致精确的深度。全宽初始化比具有受限横向发生器的电路更快地达到低相干误差，但会产生更大的噪声偏移，并且需要更多数量级的更新才能实现噪声收敛。在受多体局部化启发的初始化中，限制初始横向发生器幅度可以使算子支持保持局部化，并且足以实现低脆弱性优化，因此纵向无序和 Floquet 层重复是不必要的。故障擦除分数，即每个故障消除的相干能量的平均分数，通过无参数指数模型设置有效可见性。全宽度电路从离域操作员的支持开始，一旦相干能量建立起来，每个故障几乎都会抹掉所有能量。最初，它们的噪声引起的梯度几乎均匀地衰减相干梯度，因此相干下降以无噪声速率进行。然后，它们在高噪声力平衡平台上失速，其中有限相干和噪声引起的梯度抵消到一阶。

在后期，所有初始化都达到相同的故障擦除分数和噪声误差带，但操作员支持收缩得更慢，其速率由平台停留时间设定。

title: Information-Geometric Representation of Upper Bounds on Fluctuation Growth in Open Quantum Systems
abstract: Building on our earlier results for closed quantum systems, we investigate the dynamical evolution of quantum fluctuations and their connections to Fisher information and the quantum operations describing open-system dynamics. Starting from a general expression for the time derivative of an observable's uncertainty, we derive an alternative upper bound on fluctuation growth in an open quantum system using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. The resulting bound separates contributions from the evolution of the quantum state and the explicit time dependence of the observable, reducing to a known result for closed-system dynamics. We then establish a connection between fluctuation dynamics and quantum Fisher information by decomposing the density operator and the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) into coherent and incoherent contributions, which leads to a bound relating the evolution of observable uncertainty to the coherent and incoherent components of the Fisher information, providing an information-geometric interpretation of fluctuation growth. To connect fluctuation dynamics with quantum operations governing open-system evolutions, we derive the time evolution of the eigenvalues of the density operator in terms of Kraus operators. Using the infinitesimal-time relation between Kraus and Lindblad operators, we obtain a corresponding expression for the eigenvalue dynamics in terms of Lindblad operators. This formulation directly relates changes in the density operator eigenvalues to the quantum processes acting on the system. We then study the results using some examples. Our results provide a framework connecting observable fluctuation growth, Fisher information, and the Kraus and Lindblad descriptions of quantum evolution, offering a route toward understanding how specific quantum channels influence the information and fluctuations available in an evolving quantum system.
summary:
基于我们早期对封闭量子系统的研究结果，我们研究了量子涨落的动态演化及其与费希尔信息和描述开放系统动力学的量子运算的联系。从可观测不确定性的时间导数的一般表达式开始，我们使用柯西-施瓦茨不等式推导出开放量子系统中涨落增长的替代上限。由此产生的界限将量子态演化的贡献和可观测量的显式时间依赖性分开，减少到封闭系统动力学的已知结果。然后，我们通过将密度算子和对称对数导数（SLD）分解为相干和非相干贡献，在波动动力学和量子费希尔信息之间建立联系，这导致了可观测不确定性的演化与费希尔信息的相干和非相干成分之间的界限，从而提供了涨落增长的信息几何解释。

为了将涨落动力学与管理开放系统演化的量子运算联系起来，我们用克劳斯算子推导了密度算子特征值的时间演化。利用 Kraus 和 Lindblad 算子之间的无穷小时间关系，我们得到了 Lindblad 算子的特征值动力学的相应表达式。该公式将密度算子特征值的变化直接与作用于系统的量子过程联系起来。然后我们使用一些例子来研究结果。我们的研究结果提供了一个连接可观察波动增长、费希尔信息以及克劳斯和林德布拉德对量子演化的描述的框架，为理解特定量子通道如何影响演化量子系统中可用的信息和波动提供了一条途径。

title: Reasoning about Shared-Qubit Concurrency in Quantum Computing
abstract: In this paper, we develop a semantic model for the parallel execution of quantum circuits, providing a formal foundation for studying shared-qubit concurrency in quantum computing. As in classical shared-memory concurrency, parallel quantum circuits may interfere with one another through operations on shared qubits. However, quantum entanglement and the noncommutativity of quantum operations introduce additional challenges for reasoning about their correctness. To address these challenges, we generalise the classical Owicki-Gries method to quantum computing at the level of quantum circuits. Our approach enables compositional reasoning about parallel quantum circuits by separating the verification of individual components from the analysis of interference between them. We formulate proof rules for establishing the correctness of parallel quantum circuits and prove their soundness with respect to the proposed semantic model.
summary: 在本文中，我们开发了量子电路并行执行的语义模型，为研究量子计算中共享量子位并发性提供了正式基础。与经典的共享内存并发一样，并行量子电路可能会通过共享量子位上的操作相互干扰。然而，量子纠缠和量子运算的非交换性给推理其正确性带来了额外的挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们将经典的 Owicki-Gries 方法推广到量子电路级别的量子计算。我们的方法通过将单个组件的验证与它们之间的干扰分析分开来实现并行量子电路的组合推理。我们制定了证明规则来建立并行量子电路的正确性，并证明其对于所提出的语义模型的合理性。

title: An example of universal braiding in Links--Gould topological quantum computation
abstract: We construct a universal quantum computational encoding via braiding in Links--Gould fusion spaces associated to $U_q^H(\mathfrak{sl}(2|1))$ where $q$ is on the unit circle and is not a root of unity. The construction uses only neglectons and is realized in the morphism spaces $\mathrm{Hom}_{U_q^H}(V(0,\alpha),V(0,-\frac{1}{2})^{\otimes 2N}\otimes V(0,\alpha)).$ Under explicit positivity and arithmetic constraints these spaces admit a $2^N$-dimensional computational subspace with a positive definite Hermitian form. We prove single-qubit density in $\mathrm{U}(2,1)$ and approximate arbitrary unitary operators on $N$-qubit computational subspaces with arbitrarily small leakage. The calculations use explicit inclusions, projections, and Hermitian pairings without requiring $F$-matrices.
summary: 我们通过与 $U_q^H(\mathfrak{sl}(2|1))$ 关联的 Links--Gould 融合空间中的编织构建了通用量子计算编码，其中 $q$ 在单位圆上并且不是单位根。该构造仅使用忽略子，并在态射空间 $\mathrm{Hom}_{U_q^H}(V(0,\alpha),V(0,-\frac{1}{2})^{\otimes 2N}\otimes V(0,\alpha)) 中实现。$ 在显式正性和算术约束下，这些空间允许具有正定 Hermitian 形式的 $2^N$ 维计算子空间。我们证明了 $\mathrm{U}(2,1)$ 中的单量子位密度，并在具有任意小泄漏的 $N$-量子位计算子空间上近似任意酉算子。计算使用显式包含、投影和 Hermitian 配对，无需 $F$ 矩阵。

title: Approximate Synthetic Spectra of Quantum Systems Associated with Compact Lie Groups
abstract: How can noncommuting quantum observables retain the geometry of a classical phase space? Motivated by Mumford's question on approximately macroscopically unique (AMU) states and the work of Lin and Wang, we study synthetic spectra of position--momentum and angular-momentum systems. Under the hypotheses of their AMU theorems, nonempty synthetic spectra yield AMU states. For sufficiently small $\hbar$, the position--momentum spectrum fills the plane, while the angular-momentum spectrum contains any prescribed ball. The latter calculation leads to compact Lie groups: we prove that highest-weight coadjoint orbits lie in regional synthetic spectra under an explicit variance bound. Function-space representations of $SU(n)$, $SO(n)$, and $Sp(n)$ provide further examples.
summary: 非对易量子可观测量如何保留经典相空间的几何形状？受 Mumford 关于近似宏观唯一 (AMU) 状态的问题以及 Lin 和 Wang 的工作的启发，我们研究了位置动量和角动量系统的合成谱。根据 AMU 定理的假设，非空合成谱产生 AMU 态。对于足够小的$\hbar$，位置动量谱填充平面，而角动量谱包含任何规定的球。后一种计算导致了紧凑的李群：我们证明了最高权重的共交轨道位于显式方差界限下的区域合成谱中。 $SU(n)$、$SO(n)$ 和 $Sp(n)$ 的函数空间表示提供了进一步的示例。

title: A Conditional Quantum Kac-Bernstein Theorem
abstract: We establish a conditional quantum Kac-Bernstein theorem for mixing of two independent, finite-mode bosonic inputs with quantum memories. We characterize exactly when the outputs are conditionally independent given both memories. Each input then decomposes into orthogonal memory sectors sharing a common Gaussian state on the physical system and a bosonic memory factor, up to sector-dependent physical displacements. In particular, triviality of the common bosonic factor implies separability of the inputs, as occurs whenever either memory has finite-dimensional support.
summary: 我们建立了条件量子 Kac-Bernstein 定理，用于将两个独立的有限模式玻色输入与量子存储器混合。我们准确地描述了输出在给定两个存储器的条件下独立的情况。然后，每个输入分解为正交存储扇区，在物理系统上共享公共高斯状态和玻色存储因子，直至扇区相关的物理位移。特别是，公共玻色子因子的平凡性意味着输入的可分离性，每当任一存储器具有有限维支持时就会发生这种情况。

title: On the Hardness of Approximate Quantum Circuit Membership and Optimization
abstract: Quantum circuit optimization is an indispensable component of the quantum software stack, used to reduce noise, maximize performance, alleviate costs of quantum error correction, or target specific hardware. A related problem is approximate membership: for a fixed set of unitaries $S$, decide whether a given circuit $C$ is within distance $\varepsilon$ of a unitary in $S$ under some metric $m$. Membership is a special case of optimization, where $S$ is a set of unitaries implementable at no cost (e.g., with noise-minimal circuits, or without magic states). Janzing, Wocjan, and Beth (Int. J. Quantum Inf., 2005) showed that, for the operator metric, the case $S=\{I\}$ (approximate identity) is QMA-complete when $C$ is promised to be either close to the identity or far from it. We generalize this setting in three directions: (i) promise-free inputs, (ii) besides $S=\{I\}$, sets $S$ containing only Clifford unitaries, or only generalized permutation matrices (i.e., no superposition), and (iii) the trace-based, spectral, and operator metrics. We show that, in all cases, approximate membership is PP-hard for wide ranges of $\varepsilon$, provided $C$'s gate-set can implement Clifford+T, as the gate-sets of standard hardware do. If $S=\{I\}$, or if $S$ contains only generalized permutation matrices, $I\in S$, and $m$ is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds for all non-trivial $\varepsilon$. If $S=\{I\}$ and $m$ is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds even for circuits over classical-reversible gate-sets. Our results indicate that approximate membership is harder over promise-free inputs than the QMA-complete promise version, and that this hardness persists across quantum resources (any gates, non-Clifford, superposition) and distance metrics. They directly imply PP-hardness of circuit optimization when minimizing total, non-Clifford, or superposition gate depth or count.
summary:
量子电路优化是量子软件堆栈中不可或缺的组成部分，用于降低噪声、最大化性能、降低量子纠错成本或针对特定硬件。一个相关的问题是近似隶属度：对于一组固定的酉$S$，确定给定电路$C$是否在某个度量$m$下$S$中酉的距离$\varepsilon$之内。成员资格是优化的一种特殊情况，其中 $S$ 是一组可以免费实现的酉集合（例如，使用噪声最小电路，或没有魔法状态）。 Janzing、Wocjan 和 Beth（Int. J. Quantum Inf.，2005）表明，对于算子度量，当 $C$ 被承诺接近或远离恒等式时，$S=\{I\}$（近似恒等式）的情况是 QMA 完全的。我们在三个方向上概括此设置：(i) 无承诺输入，(ii) 除了 $S=\{I\}$ 之外，设置仅包含 Clifford 酉矩阵或仅包含广义置换矩阵（即无叠加）的 $S$，以及 (iii) 基于迹的、谱的和算子度量。

我们表明，在所有情况下，对于大范围的 $\varepsilon$，近似隶属度是 PP-hard，前提是 $C$ 的门集可以实现 Clifford+T，就像标准硬件的门集那样。如果 $S=\{I\}$，或者 $S$ 仅包含广义置换矩阵，$I\in S$，并且 $m$ 是基于迹的距离，则 PP 硬度适用于所有非平凡的 $\varepsilon$。如果 $S=\{I\}$ 和 $m$ 是基于轨迹的距离，则即使对于经典可逆门集上的电路，PP 硬度也成立。我们的结果表明，在无承诺输入上，近似隶属度比 QMA 完全承诺版本更难，并且这种难度在量子资源（任何门、非 Clifford、叠加）和距离度量中持续存在。当最小化总的、非 Clifford 的或叠加的门深度或数量时，它们直接意味着电路优化的 PP 硬度。

title: Hybrid Quantum--Classical Pauli-Correlator Architecture for Image Reconstruction
abstract: We introduce the Pauli-Correlator Autoencoder (PCAE), a hybrid quantum--classical architecture for image reconstruction. PCAE splits an image into patches and compresses each patch as a matrix product state (MPS). A small quantum circuit turns each compressed patch into a few measured numbers, and a classical neural network rebuilds the patch from these numbers and the patch position. A learnable energy term, taken from physics, is added to training and tracked as training proceeds. Two versions place the six qubits on a line (PCAE1D) or on a grid (PCAE2D). An averaging step makes the PCAE2D features follow rotations and reflections of the image exactly. Trained on one image at a time, PCAE2D rebuilds images from six public datasets with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 25.8 to 41.6 decibels. On CIFAR-10 images not used in training, a formula-based stand-in for the PCAE2D features performs within 1 decibel of several simpler classical methods. Five trained models also run on real IBM quantum computers without retraining, and rebuild images at 25.90 to 31.52 decibels. A short argument and a synthetic test show that, with a linear final layer, measuring qubits in pairs is needed for targets built from products of inputs. These results show that PCAE works as a hybrid model that rebuilds varied images and runs on today's quantum hardware at the six-qubit scale.
summary:
我们介绍泡利相关器自动编码器（PCAE），一种用于图像重建的混合量子经典架构。 PCAE 将图像分割为补丁，并将每个补丁压缩为矩阵乘积状态 (MPS)。一个小型量子电路将每个压缩补丁转换为几个测量数字，然后经典神经网络根据这些数字和补丁位置重建补丁。取自物理学的可学习能量术语被添加到训练中并随着训练的进行进行跟踪。两个版本将六个量子位放在一条线上（PCAE1D）或网格上（PCAE2D）。平均步骤使 PCAE2D 特征准确地跟随图像的旋转和反射。 PCAE2D 一次训练一张图像，从六个公共数据集重建图像，峰值信噪比为 25.8 至 41.6 分贝。在训练中未使用的 CIFAR-10 图像上，PCAE2D 特征的基于公式的替代方法的性能比几种更简单的经典方法的误差在 1 分贝以内。五个经过训练的模型也在真正的 IBM 量子计算机上运行，​​无需重新训练，并以 25.90 至 31.52 分贝重建图像。

简短的论证和综合测试表明，对于线性最终层，对于从输入的乘积构建的目标，需要成对测量量子位。这些结果表明，PCAE 作为一种混合模型工作，可以重建各种图像，并在当今的六量子位规模的量子硬件上运行。

title: Broken-Symmetry Reference States for Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization with Near-DMRG Accuracy
abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) accuracy remains limited for strongly correlated systems like iron-sulfur clusters. This accuracy heavily depends on the mean-field reference state, which determines the sampling ansatz and configuration-recovery target. We extend the qcsc-prefect workflow to support a broken-symmetry unrestricted Hartree-Fock (BS-UHF) starting point, derived from atom-localized antiferromagnetic initial guesses. For the $[Fe_4S_4(SCH_3)_4]^{2-}$ cubane (54 electrons, 36 orbitals, 72 data qubits; 88 total qubits), this lowers the mean-field reference by $\approx 534$ mHa relative to the Restricted Hartree-Fock (RHF) solution (-327.0809 vs. -326.5474 Ha). Combined with deep multi-step configuration recovery on ROQUO GPU nodes at subspace dimension $d = 3 \times 10^{10}$, we reach $E = -327.235076$ Ha. This is 4.3 mHa above the finite-$D = 4000$ DMRG value (-327.2393952 Ha) and $\sim 512-517$ mHa below a previous same-active-space RHF-reference SQD calculation. Extrapolating to the $d \to \infty$ limit via a Gaussian-in-log $d$ fitting ansatz gives an asymptotic estimate $E_\infty = -327.244468$ Ha $\pm 1.05$ mHa, just 0.33 mHa above our discarded-weight-extrapolated DMRG estimate ($E_{D\to\infty} = -327.244797$ Ha $\pm 0.46$ mHa), well within their combined $1\sigma$ uncertainty. We characterize the determinant-subspace composition driving convergence, show matching validation on $[Fe_2S_2(SCH_3)_4]^{2-}$, and report multi-HPC execution on Fugaku, Miyabi-G, and ROQUO. We conclude that reference-state preparation, rather than subspace size alone, is a key driver of SQD energy accuracy under strong electronic correlation.
summary:
对于铁硫簇等强相关系统，基于样本的量子对角化 (SQD) 精度仍然有限​​。这种精度在很大程度上取决于平均场参考状态，它决定了采样模拟和配置恢复目标。我们扩展了 qcsc-prefect 工作流程以支持破缺对称无限制 Hartree-Fock (BS-UHF) 起点，该起点源自原子局域反铁磁初始猜测。对于 $[Fe_4S_4(SCH_3)_4]^{2-}$ 立方烷（54 个电子、36 个轨道、72 个数据量子位；总共 88 个量子位），相对于受限 Hartree-Fock (RHF) 解决方案，这将平均场参考降低了 $\approx 534$ mHa（-327.0809 与 -326.5474）哈）。结合 ROQUO GPU 节点上子空间维度 $d = 3 \times 10^{10}$ 的深度多步配置恢复，我们达到 $E = -327.235076$ Ha。这比有限$D = 4000$ DMRG 值（-327.2393952 Ha）高出 4.3 mHa，比先前相同活动空间 RHF 参考 SQD 计算低 $\sim 512-517$ mHa。

通过高斯对数 $d$ 拟合 ansatz 外推到 $d \to \infty$ 限制给出渐近估计 $E_\infty = -327.244468$ Ha $\pm 1.05$ mHa，仅比我们的丢弃权重外推 DMRG 估计高 0.33 mHa ($E_{D\to\infty} = -327.244797$ Ha $\pm 0.46$ mHa)，完全在其组合的 $1\sigma$ 不确定性之内。我们描述了驱动收敛的行列式子空间组成，显示了 $[Fe_2S_2(SCH_3)_4]^{2-}$ 上的匹配验证，并报告了 Fugaku、Miyabi-G 和 ROQUO 上的多 HPC 执行情况。我们得出的结论是，参考态准备，而不仅仅是子空间大小，是强电子关联下 SQD 能量精度的关键驱动因素。

title: Motional Decoherence of the internal state of an atom by vacuum and thermal fluctuations of a quantum field: Necessity of a fully relativistic treatment
abstract: We consider a massive object, such as a neutral atom or an Unruh-DeWitt detector, moving at constant speed in a quantum field and investigate how motion affects the quantum coherence of its internal degrees of freedom, manifesting as quantum dispersion in the absence of a quantum field, and decoherence in its presence. Our investigation aims to serve two purposes: One is to obtain the correct results for these effects, which are essential for the design of quantum information processing schemes where the quantum coherence of an atom's internal degrees of freedom is of major concern. The other is to expose the fallacies in commonplace approaches, which start with a non-relativistic calculation and then add on relativistic ``corrections". We first show a fully relativistic calculation of the internal dynamics based on covariance principles, and then one which ignores these principles, often justified by the atom's slow motion. By a direct comparison of results from these two approaches, we identify {significant discrepancies} in a non-relativistic treatment, even at low atomic speeds. The proper procedure, and a much safer one in terms of accuracy, is recommended here: first derive the dynamics and the necessary regularizations within a fully covariant relativistic framework. Only after the exact, internally consistent equations of motion are established should low-velocity limits be extracted from them. Only in this way can all the relativistic effects which matter: time dilation, aberration, non-inertial mass shifts, be systematically preserved, and accurate results obtained.
summary:
我们考虑一个大质量物体，例如中性原子或安鲁-德威特探测器，在量子场中以恒定速度移动，并研究运动如何影响其内部自由度的量子相干性，在没有量子场的情况下表现为量子色散，在存在量子场的情况下表现为退相干。我们的研究旨在达到两个目的：一是获得这些效应的正确结果，这对于设计量子信息处理方案至关重要，其中原子内部自由度的量子相干性是主要关注点。另一种是揭露常见方法中的谬误，这些方法从非相对论计算开始，然后添加相对论“校正”。我们首先展示基于协方差原理的内部动力学的完全相对论计算，然后是忽略这些原理的计算，通常通过原子的慢运动来证明合理。通过直接比较这两种方法的结果，我们识别出非相对论处理中的{显着差异}，即使是在低原子速度。

这里推荐正确的程序，并且在准确性方面更安全的程序：首先在完全协变的相对论框架内导出动力学和必要的正则化。只有在建立了精确的、内部一致的运动方程之后，才可以从中提取低速限制。只有这样，才能系统地保留所有重要的相对论效应：时间膨胀、像差、非惯性质量位移，并获得准确的结果。

title: Decoy-state quantum key distribution with a leaky Mach-Zehnder receiver
abstract: We prove the security of phase-encoded decoy-state BB84 quantum key distribution for a Mach-Zehnder receiver with imbalanced beam splitters and two threshold detectors that leak fine-grained information about the detection patterns. For this, we derive a lower bound on Bob's single-photon contributions and combine it with the decoy-state method and a recent phase-error framework for leaky receivers. The leakage-induced correction to the phase-error rate is independent of channel loss, providing a loss-tolerant treatment of receiver leakage even in the presence of beam-splitter imbalance. Our results provide a practical route toward loss-tolerant security proofs for imperfect QKD receivers in the presence of receiver leakage.
summary: 我们证明了马赫曾德接收器的相位编码诱饵状态 BB84 量子密钥分发的安全性，该接收器具有不平衡分束器和两个阈值检测器，可泄漏有关检测模式的细粒度信息。为此，我们推导出 Bob 的单光子贡献的下限，并将其与诱饵状态方法和泄漏接收器的最新相位误差框架相结合。泄漏引起的相位误差率校正与通道损耗无关，即使在存在分束器不平衡的情况下，也可以对接收器泄漏提供容损处理。我们的结果为在存在接收器泄漏的情况下不完美的 QKD 接收器提供了一种容丢安全证明的实用途径。

title: Time-invariant negativity and persistent bound entanglement in a cyclic two-qutrit family
abstract: We study the entanglement dynamics of two qutrits under collective dephasing for a family of states obtained by mixing a maximally entangled state that lives in the decoherence-free subspace with three nonstationary two-term states sharing a common amplitude ratio $r$. We obtain exact PPT and separability regions along the whole trajectory, a specialization of known results on cyclic sign invariant states, and we supply explicit certificates: a finite product decomposition, three fixed positive-map witnesses, and a closed realignment formula that detects every PPT-entangled state, so that no state is left undecided. The negativity is computed in closed form. It shows that the entanglement is time-invariant, positive and constant from the initial time although the state changes, exactly when the weight of the maximally entangled state exceeds the threshold $U_r=r/(1+r+r^2)$. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of time-invariant entanglement for qutrit--qutrit systems under collective dephasing. For smaller weights the entanglement decays and vanishes at a finite time: the state either becomes separable (entanglement sudden death) or, for $r\neq1$ in an intermediate range, loses distillability suddenly and remains bound entangled at all later times. Every state with negative partial transpose is one-copy distillable by a fixed local projection. The same trajectories arise from the global dephasing map and from a correlated local random-unitary semigroup, although the two channels differ on product inputs. Exact rational benchmarks and embeddings of the Horodecki and Ha--Kye--Park families are provided.
summary:
我们研究了两个量子体在集体相移下的纠缠动力学，该状态族是通过将存在于无退相干子空间中的最大纠缠态与共享共同振幅比 $r$ 的三个非平稳两项态混合而获得的。我们沿着整个轨迹获得精确的 PPT 和可分离区域，这是循环符号不变状态已知结果的专门化，并且我们提供显式证书：有限乘积分解、三个固定的正映射见​​证以及检测每个 PPT 纠缠状态的封闭重排公式，以便没有未确定的状态。负值以封闭形式计算。它表明，尽管状态发生了变化，但当最大纠缠态的权重超过阈值 $U_r=r/(1+r+r^2)$ 时，纠缠是时不变的、正的且从初始时间开始恒定。据我们所知，这是集体移相下 qutrit-qutrit 系统时不变纠缠的首次演示。

对于较小的权重，纠缠会在有限的时间内衰减并消失：状态要么变得可分离（纠缠突然死亡），要么对于中间范围内的$r\neq1$，突然失去可蒸馏性并在以后的所有时间中保持束缚纠缠。每个具有负部分转置的状态都可以通过固定的局部投影进行单副本蒸馏。尽管两个通道在产品输入上不同，但全局相移图和相关局部随机酉半群产生相同的轨迹。提供了 Horodecki 和 Ha--Kye--Park 族的精确理性基准和嵌入。

title: On Random Purifications of Isometries and Channels
abstract: Acorn tricks turn weak quantum resources into stronger "randomized" ones. A recent example is the random purification channel, which turns $t$ copies of a mixed state into $t$ copies of a random purification. We ask whether analogous techniques can turn queries to an isometry into queries to a random unitary completion, or queries to a quantum channel into queries to a random isometry dilation. For an isometry from dimension $N$ to dimension $M$, we give an efficient, stateful simulator for $T$ sequential, forward queries to a fixed Haar random unitary completion. It uses at most one forward isometry query per simulated call, with total trace-distance error $O(T\sqrt{N/(M-T)})$. This lifts isometry query lower bounds to arbitrary unitary completions, and copy complexity lower bounds to forward access to state preparation unitaries, with dimension-dependent loss that can be made arbitrarily small for most applications. Conversely, we construct two distributions on quantum channels distinguishable exactly with two queries to an arbitrary dilation, but requiring exponentially many channel queries for nonnegligible advantage. This rules out efficient simulation of random channel dilations. Our technique also shows that approximating the quantum switch to any constant error below $1/2$ requires exponentially many channel queries, even for identical channels, giving an exponential query advantage for indefinite causal order and improving on Bavaresco et al. (2025). Finally, we show how to "decontrol" controlled forward access to an isometry: any algorithm making controlled queries to $\phi V$ for a random phase $\phi$ can be transformed into one using the same number of uncontrolled forward queries to $V$, generalizing the analogous result for unitaries.
summary:
橡子技巧将弱量子资源变成更强的“随机”资源。最近的一个例子是随机净化通道，它将混合状态的 $t$ 副本转换为随机净化的 $t$ 副本。我们询问类似的技术是否可以将对等距的查询转变为对随机单一完成的查询，或者对量子通道的查询转变为对随机等距扩张的查询。对于从维度 $N$ 到维度 $M$ 的等距，我们为 $T$ 顺序、转发查询到固定 Haar 随机单一完成提供了一个高效、有状态的模拟器。每个模拟调用最多使用一次正向等距查询，总跟踪距离误差为 $O(T\sqrt{N/(M-T)})$。这将等距查询下界提升到任意单一完成，并复制复杂性下界以转发对状态准备单一的访问，对于大多数应用程序来说，维度相关的损失可以任意小。相反，我们在量子通道上构建了两个分布，可以通过对任意膨胀的两次查询来精确区分，但需要指数级数量的通道查询才能获得不可忽视的优势。

这排除了随机通道扩张的有效模拟。我们的技术还表明，将量子开关逼近到低于 1/2$ 的任何恒定误差需要指数级数量的通道查询，即使对于相同的通道也是如此，这为不确定因果顺序提供了指数查询优势，并改进了 Bavaresco 等人。 （2025）。最后，我们展示了如何“解除控制”对等轴测图的受控前向访问：任何对随机阶段 $\phi$ 进行受控查询 $\phi V$ 的算法都可以转换为使用与 $V$ 相同数量的不受控前向查询的算法，从而概括了酉的类似结果。

title: Spectral Quantum Memory for Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) model signals as continuous functions from coordinates to values, but their performance depends strongly on how spectral capacity is allocated. Yet most Quantum INR (QINR) architectures treat spectral components as independent outputs of separate quantum blocks. We introduce the Spectral Quantum Memory Model (SQMM), a memory coupled quantum INR in which sequential hybrid data reuploading layers (bands) communicate through a shared coherent quantum memory register. Each band reads the memory, computes on its own coordinate upload, and writes part of its state back, so later bands can build on the computation of earlier ones. When memory read and write layers are input independent, we prove that the memory state forms an operator valued Fourier series whose support is contained in the Minkowski sum of the initial memory spectrum and the local band spectra. Downstream bands then condition their Fourier coefficients on the spectral content stored by earlier bands, and the memory coupling creates no new primitive frequencies. This theory motivates a spectral memory alignment loss that encourages memory to encode the spectrum expressed by the deployed prefix of the model. Across audio and image reconstruction benchmarks, SQMM improves over compact QINR and INR baselines.
summary:
隐式神经表示（INR）将信号建模为从坐标到值的连续函数，但它们的性能在很大程度上取决于频谱容量的分配方式。然而，大多数量子 INR (QINR) 架构将频谱分量视为单独量子块的独立输出。我们引入了光谱量子存储模型 (SQMM)，这是一种与量子 INR 耦合的存储器，其中顺序混合数据重新上传层（带）通过共享相干量子存储寄存器进行通信。每个带读取内存，计算自己的坐标上传，并将其部分状态写回，因此后面的带可以建立在早期带的计算基础上。当内存读写层与输入无关时，我们证明内存状态形成一个算子值傅里叶级数，其支持包含在初始内存谱和局部带谱的 Minkowski 和中。然后，下游频段根据早期频段存储的频谱内容调整其傅立叶系数，并且存储器耦合不会创建新的原始频率。

该理论激发了光谱记忆对齐损失，从而鼓励记忆对模型部署的前缀表示的光谱进行编码。在音频和图像重建基准中，SQMM 比紧凑的 QINR 和 INR 基线有所改进。

title: Bulk and edge states in Fibonacci-Bose-Hubbard clusters
abstract: We study the one- and two-boson energy subspaces of finite open Bose--Hubbard chains with Fibonacci-modulated hopping and zero on-site potential. Their spectra exhibit a hierarchy of bands and gaps, and a critical zero-energy mode for odd lengths, in agreement with prior research. For the singe-excitation subspace we find two families of length-invariant finite-energy states localized at the left cluster boundary. For the two-boson subspace, we report both doublon and separated-pair excitations in the form of Tamm/Shockley states localized near either end. In particular, the right-edge doublon states occur across all Fibonacci generations whereas the left-side states appear every second generation. We check numerically that the second-order perturbation theory accounts well for the structure of the spectrum and the edge states in the doublon subspace in the strong-coupling regime. The results are useful for future explorations of many-body physics beyond numerical tractability, specifically using near-term Josephson quantum simulators.
summary: 我们研究了具有斐波那契调制跳跃和零现场势的有限开放 Bose-Hubbard 链的一和二玻色子能量子空间。它们的光谱表现出能带和能隙的层次结构，以及奇数长度的临界零能量模式，与之前的研究一致。对于单激发子空间，我们发现两个位于左簇边界的长度不变的有限能量态族。对于双玻色子子空间，我们报告了位于两端附近的塔姆/肖克利态形式的双子激发和分离对激发。特别是，右边缘双倍状态出现在所有斐波那契代中，而左侧状态每隔两代出现一次。我们通过数值检验发现二阶微扰理论很好地解释了强耦合状态下双布朗子空间的谱结构和边缘态。这些结果对于未来对超出数值可处理性的多体物理的探索非常有用，特别是使用近期的约瑟夫森量子模拟器。

title: Fast verification of fault tolerant magic state preparation circuits with the CNOT + T gate set
abstract: Magic state preparation is often among the most expensive operations in a fault tolerant quantum computation. One obstacle to coming up with better magic state preparation circuits lies in verifying their fault tolerance properties, as it is difficult to verify either by hand or in software that a very large number of combinations of faults do not give rise to high-weight or logical errors, especially in a non-Clifford circuit. In this work, we propose the use of the CNOT + T gate set to fault-tolerantly prepare a large class of magic states. We consider the propagation of Pauli faults within CNOT + T circuits and derive properties similar to those of Pauli faults within Clifford circuits, with a view to verifying fault tolerance as efficiently as possible. We present Comb, a library that can verify the fault tolerance of CNOT + T magic state preparation circuits, and demonstrate its use in verifying the fault tolerance of distance three and distance five magic state preparation circuits in minutes on a laptop. We present a distance five magic state preparation circuit that was discovered using Comb. As an independent confirmation of Comb's correctness we compare its findings to circuit-level noisy simulations for several magic state preparation circuits.
summary:
魔态准备通常是容错量子计算中最昂贵的操作之一。提出更好的魔态准备电路的一个障碍在于验证其容错特性，因为很难通过手工或软件验证大量的故障组合不会引起高权重或逻辑错误，特别是在非 Clifford 电路中。在这项工作中，我们建议使用 CNOT + T 门集来容错地准备一大类魔法状态。我们考虑 CNOT + T 电路中 Pauli 故障的传播，并推导与 Clifford 电路中 Pauli 故障类似的属性，以期尽可能有效地验证容错能力。我们提出了 Comb，一个可以验证 CNOT + T 魔态准备电路容错性的库，并演示了它在笔记本电脑上在几分钟内验证距离三和距离五魔态准备电路容错性的用途。我们提出了使用 Comb 发现的距离五魔法状态准备电路。

作为对 Comb 正确性的独立确认，我们将其发现与几个神奇状态准备电路的电路级噪声模拟进行了比较。

title: Substantially Improved Rate and Distance for Addressable Transversal Phase Gates
abstract: An important ingredient in fault-tolerant quantum computation is asymptotically good codes with fully addressable transversal non-Clifford gates. Existing constructions, however, provide only small explicit guarantees for rate and relative distance. Here, we substantially improve these guarantees for fully addressable transversal phase gates at every fixed level $h\ge3$ of the Clifford hierarchy, using a cyclic encoding beyond the binary CSS framework. The encoding separates logical phase control from the joint design of rate and distance, enabling two constructions with different computational costs. A deterministic polynomial-time algebraic-geometric construction gives a common asymptotic lower bound of $52/(675h)$ on both quantities. A counting argument gives an exponential-time construction with exact verification, improving this bound by a factor of approximately $2.86$. We further establish a universal upper bound for codes supporting fully addressable transversal single-qubit phase gates. Within our cyclic encoding framework, we obtain a stronger upper bound that is approximately $1.28$ times the lower bound achieved by our exponential-time construction. As concrete examples, we construct codes with $48$ and $90$ physical qubits supporting fully addressable transversal $T$ gates. These results narrow the gap between achievable code parameters and addressability bounds, providing quantitative targets for further improvements in efficient code constructions.
summary:
容错量子计算的一个重要组成部分是具有完全可寻址横向非克利福德门的渐进良好代码。然而，现有的结构仅对速率和相对距离提供很小的明确保证。在这里，我们使用超越二进制 CSS 框架的循环编码，大大改进了 Clifford 层次结构每个固定级别 $h\ge3$ 上完全可寻址横向相位门的这些保证。该编码将逻辑相位控制与速率和距离的联合设计分开，从而实现具有不同计算成本的两种结构。确定性多项式时间代数几何构造给出了两个量的共同渐近下界 $52/(675h)$。计数参数给出了具有精确验证的指数时间结构，将这个界限提高了大约 2.86 美元。我们进一步为支持完全可寻址横向单量子位相门的代码建立了通用上限。在我们的循环编码框架中，我们获得了一个更强的上限，大约是指数时间构造所实现的下限的 1.28 美元倍。

作为具体示例，我们构建了具有 48 美元和 90 美元物理量子位的代码，支持完全可寻址横向 $T$ 门。这些结果缩小了可实现的代码参数和可寻址范围之间的差距，为进一步改进高效代码构造提供了定量目标。

title: Synchronization Mpemba Effect
abstract: We introduce the synchronization Mpemba effect, in which a less synchronized initial state overtakes a more synchronized one, and demonstrate it in dissipatively coupled quantum van der Pol oscillators. Within a graph-Laplacian framework, we show that for two oscillators, the mechanism is a competition between a slowly decaying collective background and a fast transverse transient, equivalently an exchange between relative-mode displacement and phase-fluctuation errors. The same decomposition extends to networks: the synchronization error splits into transverse Laplacian modes, yielding closed-form crossing times from eigenvalue separations and initial mode weights, and a sufficient screening criterion. With only these eigenvalues entering, the rule is topology independent: crossing times of different networks collapse onto a single spectral-gap line. Thus, quantum many-body dynamics can be designed and controlled at low dimension without constructing the exponentially large Liouvillian, opening a route to quantum synchronization as a resource.
summary: 我们引入了同步 Mpemba 效应，即较不同步的初始状态取代较同步的初始状态，并在耗散耦合量子范德波尔振荡器中进行了演示。在图拉普拉斯框架内，我们表明，对于两个振荡器，其机制是缓慢衰减的集体背景和快速横向瞬态之间的竞争，相当于相对模式位移和相位波动误差之间的交换。相同的分解扩展到网络：同步误差分裂成横向拉普拉斯模式，从特征值分离和初始模式权重产生闭合形式交叉时间，以及充分的筛选标准。只要输入这些特征值，该规则就与拓扑无关：不同网络的交叉时间会折叠到一条谱间隙线上。因此，量子多体动力学可以在低维下进行设计和控制，而无需构建指数级大的刘维尔方程，从而开辟了一条以量子同步为资源的途径。

title: Recoverability of Gravitational Entanglement under Decoherence
abstract: Decoherence can make gravitationally generated entanglement arbitrarily small, or even vanishing, without necessarily rendering the effective matter dynamics separable. We ask whether this hidden non-separability can be revealed using strictly local quantum error correction. For Newtonian gravity supplemented by physically relevant localization noise, including environmental noise, and noise from collapse models such as GRW, CSL, and Diósi--Penrose, we analyze when the underlying entangling resource is locally recoverable. For GRW- and CSL-type noise, we analytically establish that strictly local quantum error correction can make the ratio of the effective gravitational interaction strength to the residual decoherence rate arbitrarily large for any parametrization of the collapse model, even in regimes where the unencoded entanglement signal approaches zero. By contrast, the Diósi--Penrose model does not exhibit the same enhancement under bipartite protocol considered here, revealing a qualitative difference. These results show that the loss of detectable entanglement is not equivalent to the loss of a recoverable non-separable resource, and open a route toward practical recovery protocols.
summary:
退相干可以使引力产生的纠缠变得任意小，甚至消失，而不必使有效的物质动力学可分离。我们询问是否可以使用严格的局部量子纠错来揭示这种隐藏的不可分离性。对于牛顿引力，辅以物理相关的局域噪声，包括环境噪声以及来自 GRW、CSL 和 Diósi--Penrose 等塌陷模型的噪声，我们分析了底层纠缠资源何时可在本地恢复。对于 GRW 和 CSL 型噪声，我们通过分析确定，严格的局部量子误差校正可以使有效引力相互作用强度与残余退相干率的比率对于塌缩模型的​​任何参数化而言任意大，即使在未编码的纠缠信号接近零的情况下也是如此。相比之下，Diósi--Penrose 模型在此处考虑的二分协议下并未表现出相同的增强，揭示了质的差异。

这些结果表明，可检测到的纠缠的损失并不等同于可恢复的不可分离资源的损失，并为实际的恢复协议开辟了道路。

title: Reopening the one clean qubit case of a semi-grand challenge
abstract: In his 2005 list of semi-grand challenges for quantum computing theory, Scott Aaronson asked whether a quantum computer that is always in a separable mixed state can be simulated by a classical computer in polynomial time. An affirmative answer was claimed for the one clean qubit model of quantum computation. The supporting mathematical arguments relied on an exhaustive characterization of circuits that stay in separable states. Here, we give a counterexample where one pure qubit, known as the clean qubit, controls a sequence of three gates that act on a maximally mixed three-qubit register. The overall unitary that accumulates as these gates are applied has the properties that ensure the state of all four qubits remains fully separable. Crucially, we show that the final unitary cannot be put into the form required by the claimed simulation result. We also give a continuous-time implementation of the same circuit that keeps the qubits fully separable throughout and ends at the same unitary. We extend our counterexamples to a uniform family, and pinpoint the gap in the earlier proof. Since our circuits are themselves efficient to simulate classically, this work does not settle Aaronson's question. It does, however, reopen the semi-grand challenge for an actively researched model of quantum computation.
summary:
Scott Aaronson 在 2005 年列出的量子计算理论的半重大挑战中提出，经典计算机是否可以在多项式时间内模拟始终处于可分离混合状态的量子计算机。量子计算的一个干净的量子位模型得到了肯定的答案。支持的数学论证依赖于对处于可分离状态的电路的详尽表征。在这里，我们给出一个反例，其中一个纯量子位（称为干净量子位）控制一系列三个门，这些门作用于最大混合的三量子位寄存器。应用这些门时累积的整体酉具有确保所有四个量子位的状态保持完全可分离的属性。至关重要的是，我们表明最终的酉不能放入所声称的模拟结果所需的形式。我们还给出了同一电路的连续时间实现，使量子位始终完全可分离，并以相同的单位结束。我们将反例扩展到统一族，并指出早期证明中的差距。

由于我们的电路本身可以有效地进行经典模拟，因此这项工作并没有解决阿伦森的问题。然而，它确实对积极研究的量子计算模型重新提出了半重大挑战。

title: QECert: Formal Foundations for Quantum Error-Correction Theory in Lean
abstract: Quantum error correction provides the mathematical basis for protecting quantum information against noise. Existing formalizations have established foundations for stabilizer codes and code verification. However, a systematic formal treatment of the asymptotic constructions and fundamental limitations that underpin scalable quantum error correction is still needed. We present QECert, a Lean library providing reusable formal foundations for these theoretical questions. It connects quantum error-correction criteria, stabilizer and Calderbank-Shor-Steane codes, and algebraic and homological constructions within a common framework. Asymptotically good quantum low density parity check codes provide the principal case study. We formalize constructions and asymptotic parameter theorems spanning hypergraph products, balanced products, lifted products, and quantum Tanner codes. Further developments cover Bravyi-Poulin-Terhal bounds and related locality restrictions, constant overhead magic state distillation, and energy barriers and storage errors for quantum memories. QECert establishes a reusable formal foundation for studying the capabilities, resource requirements, and fundamental limitations of quantum error correction, supporting systematic verification and further development of its theory.
summary:
量子纠错为保护量子信息免受噪声影响提供了数学基础。现有的形式化已经为稳定器代码和代码验证奠定了基础。然而，仍然需要对支持可扩展量子纠错的渐近结构和基本限制进行系统的形式处理。我们推出了 QECert，一个精益库，为这些理论问题提供可重用的形式基础。它将量子纠错准则、稳定器和 Calderbank-Shor-Steane 代码以及通用框架内的代数和同调结构连接起来。渐近良好的量子低密度奇偶校验码提供了主要的案例研究。我们形式化了跨越超图积、平衡积、提升积和量子坦纳码的构造和渐近参数定理。进一步的发展包括 Bravyi-Poulin-Terhal 界限和相关的局域性限制、恒定开销魔态蒸馏以及量子存储器的能量势垒和存储错误。

QECert 为研究量子纠错的能力、资源需求和基本局限性建立了可重用的形式基础，支持系统验证和理论的进一步发展。

title: Operational Thresholds for Long-Range Entanglement in Quantum Networks
abstract: Quantum networks distribute entanglement between distant nodes by combining many short entangled links using local quantum operations. These operations only succeed probabilistically, yet existing percolation-based theories of entanglement transmission treat them as perfect. We approach the problem through statistical physics, using a stochastic generalization of concurrence percolation to determine how reliable local operations must be for long-range entanglement to remain possible. On hierarchical $(U,V)$-flower networks, which permit full analytical control across network scales, we derive an exact renormalization recursion for the probability that an end-to-end entangled connection survives. For the $(2,2)$-flower this yields a closed-form operational phase boundary, $\eta_p = 2 - \frac{32}{27}\eta_s$, where $\eta_s$ and $\eta_p$ are the success probabilities of the series (entanglement swapping) and parallel (purification) operations, respectively. At this boundary the survival probability jumps discontinuously from $0$ to $S_\infty = 3/(4\eta_s)$. Numerically propagating the full distribution of end-to-end concurrence yields a second threshold in the initial link quality, which varies continuously with operational reliability. Above both thresholds the large-network state is binary: the connection either fails outright or approaches a perfect Bell pair. Our results thus reveal a two-threshold structure for long-range entanglement, in which operational reliability and initial link quality can compensate one another. Operational success rates therefore emerge alongside initial link quality as a primary design constraint for scalable quantum networks.
summary:
量子网络通过使用本地量子操作组合许多短纠缠链路来分布遥远节点之间的纠缠。这些操作只能在概率上成功，但现有的基于渗透的纠缠传输理论将它们视为完美的。我们通过统计物理学来解决这个问题，使用并发渗透的随机概括来确定局部操作必须有多可靠才能使远程纠缠保持可能。在允许跨网络规模进行全面分析控制的分层 $(U,V)$-flower 网络上，我们导出了端到端纠缠连接存活概率的精确重整化递归。对于$(2,2)$花，这会产生一个封闭形式的操作相边界，$\eta_p = 2 - \frac{32}{27}\eta_s$，其中$\eta_s$和$\eta_p$分别是串联（纠缠交换）和并行（净化）操作的成功概率。在此边界处，生存概率从 $0$ 不连续地跳跃到 $S_\infty = 3/(4\eta_s)$。

Numerically propagating the full distribution of end-to-end concurrence yields a second threshold in the initial link quality, which varies continuously with operational reliability.高于这两个阈值时，大型网络状态是二元的：连接要么彻底失败，要么接近完美的贝尔对。 Our results thus reveal a two-threshold structure for long-range entanglement, in which operational reliability and initial link quality can compensate one another.因此，操作成功率与初始链路质量一起成为可扩展量子网络的主要设计约束。

title: Data informed Ansatz Selection for Variational Quantum Circuits
abstract: Choosing a variational quantum circuit (VQC) usually means searching over ansatze and depths, and training each candidate. We give three rules that fix these choices from the data and the gate set alone, before any training. First, a circuit without entangling gates has a rank-one Fourier coefficient tensor on every subset of qubits. A singular value decomposition of a dataset's Fourier coefficients therefore indicates whether entanglement is needed, which qubits it connects, and a lower bound on the error of omitting it. Second, the rank of the quantum Fisher information matrix grows by $p_0$ per layer, after a first-layer deficit $d_0$, until it reaches a ceiling set by the dynamical Lie algebra. This law fixes the depth. Third, reading out all $2^N - 1$ Pauli-Z products from one batch of shots resolves half of the state's directions, the most any single-basis readout can. A single-qubit readout resolves an exponentially small fraction. For the Madelon dataset, the rules prescribe 7 blocks of 3 qubits at depth 3: a 239-parameter classifier with 78.5% test accuracy, found without a grid search. Ablations confirm three predicted effects: shallower circuits, smaller blocks and dropping reuploading all lower accuracy.
summary:
选择变分量子电路（VQC）通常意味着搜索模拟和深度，并训练每个候选者。在任何训练之前，我们给出了三个规则来单独从数据和门集中修复这些选择。首先，没有纠缠门的电路在每个量子位子集上都有一个一阶傅里叶系数张量。因此，数据集傅立叶系数的奇异值分解表明是否需要纠缠、它连接哪些量子位，以及忽略纠缠的错误下限。其次，在第一层赤字 $d_0$ 之后，量子费希尔信息矩阵的秩每层增长 $p_0$，直到达到动态李代数设定的上限。该定律确定了深度。第三，从一批镜头中读出所有 $2^N - 1$ Pauli-Z 产品可以解决一半的州指示，这是任何单基读出所能解决的最大问题。单量子位读数可以解析指数级的小分数。对于 Madelon 数据集，规则规定深度为 3 的 7 个 3 个量子位块：一个 239 个参数的分类器，测试准确度为 78.5%，无需网格搜索即可找到。

消融证实了三种预测效果：更浅的电路、更小的块以及放弃重新上传所有较低的精度。

title: Comment on "Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings" (arXiv:2610.26833)
abstract: We discuss the relationship between quantum Hamiltonian embeddings ( arXiv:2610.26833 ) and prior developments in Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML), including QCML's earlier implementation on IBM quantum hardware. We consider the novelty claims and the computational role of encoding an entire dataset in a single ground state.
summary: 我们讨论量子哈密顿嵌入 (arXiv:2610.26833) 与量子认知机器学习 (QCML) 的先前发展之间的关系，包括 QCML 在 IBM 量子硬件上的早期实现。我们考虑新颖性主张以及在单个基态下编码整个数据集的计算作用。

title: Quantum Query Lower Bounds from Classical Moment Matching
abstract: We prove a quantum analogue of the classical moment matching method, a popular framework used to prove lower bounds in property testing. For two random variables $X_0$ and $X_1$ whose moments match up to the first $r-1$ moments, the classical moment matching method says that no classical algorithm can reliably distinguish between input instances of length $N$ constructed from $X_0$ and $X_1$, respectively, unless it performs at least $\Omega(N^{1-1/r})$ queries. While this method has been widely explored since its inception in the seminal work of Raskhodnikova, Ron, Shpilka, and Smith (STOC 2007) to prove lower bounds for symmetric properties, it has remained an open question whether a quantum analogue of it could be proved. We prove two variants of this quantum moment matching method, which are incomparable. Our first quantum query lower bound scales as $\Omega(N^{1/2-1/(2r)})$, while our second moment matching theorem yields a sharper lower bound of $\Omega(N^{1/2-1/(2(2^r-1))})$, albeit for smaller parameter ranges. Our results combine a new continuous hybrid argument with the polynomial method. The continuous hybrid argument compares two hard input distributions generated from i.i.d. samples by continuously varying both distributions, keeping them identically distributed at every intermediate stage. It reduces the comparison to the effect of changing the distribution of a single sample. The polynomial method then cancels the terms determined by the matched moments. We apply these moment matching theorems to prove new optimal lower bounds on $k$-distinctness, $k$-star-freeness, planarity and outerplanarity testing, as well as to improve prior lower bounds on image size testing and $K$-junta testing by logarithmic factors. A key advantage of our framework is its simplicity: it reduces quantum lower bound proofs to the construction of suitable moment-matching distributions.
summary:
我们证明了经典矩匹配方法的量子模拟，这是一种用于证明属性测试下限的流行框架。对于两个随机变量 $X_0$ 和 $X_1$ 的矩与第一个 $r-1$ 矩匹配，经典矩匹配方法表示，没有经典算法能够可靠地区分分别由 $X_0$ 和 $X_1$ 构造的长度为 $N$ 的输入实例，除非它至少执行 $\Omega(N^{1-1/r})$ 查询。虽然这种方法自 Raskhodnikova、Ron、Shpilka 和 Smith 的开创性工作（STOC 2007）提出以来已被广泛探索，以证明对称性质的下界，但是否可以证明它的量子类似物仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们证明了这种量子矩匹配方法的两种变体，它们是无法比较的。我们的第一个量子查询下界尺度为 $\Omega(N^{1/2-1/(2r)})$，而我们的二阶矩匹配定理产生更清晰的下界 $\Omega(N^{1/2-1/(2(2^r-1))})$，尽管参数范围较小。我们的结果将新的连续混合论证与多项式方法相结合。

连续混合参数比较由独立同分布生成的两个硬输入分布。通过不断改变两个分布来进行采样，使它们在每个中间阶段保持相同的分布。它减少了与改变单个样本分布的效果的比较。然后多项式方法取消由匹配矩确定的项。我们应用这些矩匹配定理来证明 $k$-distinctness、$k$-star-freeness、平面性和外平面性测试的新最优下界，以及通过对数因子改进图像尺寸测试和 $K$-junta 测试的先前下界。我们框架的一个关键优势是它的简单性：它将量子下界证明减少到构建合适的矩匹配分布。

title: Effective Hamiltonians and non-Hermitian physics
abstract: Every realistic quantum system is coupled to an environment. Including the environment restores a closed, Hermitian description, but at the cost of an intractably large Hilbert space. The Feshbach--Löwdin projection eliminates the unwanted degrees of freedom exactly, yielding an effective Hamiltonian $H_{\rm eff}$ on the relevant subspace alone---which \new{generically becomes non-Hermitian when the eliminated subspace contains an energetically accessible continuum and outgoing boundary conditions are imposed}. We illustrate this through a minimal model: a particle in a box with a delta barrier at its center. Direct elimination of one half-well reduces all information about the discarded sector to a single \new{boundary parameter} $\beta$; the same result is then rederived via the Green's function and Dyson equation, offering a pedagogical illustration of how boundary data enter the Green's-function formalism and relating $\beta$ to a self-energy term. Whether $\beta$ is real or complex determines whether $H_{\rm eff}$ is Hermitian or not, and the full range of behavior---from Hermitian dynamics through finite-width resonances to the counterintuitive quantum Zeno effect---follows from this single parameter.
summary:
每个现实的量子系统都与环境耦合。包括环境恢复了封闭的厄米式描述，但代价是难以处理的大希尔伯特空间。 Feshbach--Löwdin 投影精确地消除了不需要的自由度，仅在相关子空间上产生有效的哈密顿量 $H_{\rm eff}$ ——当消除的子空间包含能量上可访问的连续体并施加传出边界条件时，\new{通常会变成非厄米式}。我们通过一个最小模型来说明这一点：一个盒子中的粒子，其中心有一个 delta 势垒。直接消除一个半井将有关被丢弃扇区的所有信息减少为单个 \new{边界参数} $\beta$；然后通过格林函数和戴森方程重新得出相同的结果，提供边界数据如何进入格林函数形式主义并将 $\beta$ 与自能项相关联的教学说明。

$\beta$ 是实数还是复数决定了 $H_{\rm eff}$ 是否是埃尔米特式的，并且从埃尔米特式动力学到有限宽度共振再到反直觉的量子芝诺效应的全部行为都遵循这个单一参数。

title: Quantum Advantage has Few Complexity Implications
abstract: We consider the complexity implications of proofs of quantumness and (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation. We show that both of these objects can coexist with the easiness of nondeterministic computation. That is, we give evidence that proofs of quantumness can exist when $\mathsf{P} = \mathsf{NP}$ and that (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation can exist when $\mathsf{BQP} = \mathsf{QCMA}$. In particular, we give a classical oracle relative to which (1) $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{NP}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{PSPACE}^\mathcal{O}$ (3) Proofs of quantumness exist. In particular, there exists a language in $\mathsf{IP}^\mathcal{O} \subseteq \mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O}$ which is hard on average against $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O}/poly$. We give a unitary oracle such that (1) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{QCMA}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) Quantum verifier oblivious state preparation exists. These oracle separations directly imply a number of related consequences. For example, our first result implies that proofs of quantumness cannot be used to construct classical or quantum cryptography with a relativizing proof. Our second result implies that quantum computation/classical communication oblivious transfer cannot be used to construct post-quantum one-way functions with a relativizing proof.
summary:
我们考虑量子性证明和（量子验证者）不经意状态准备的复杂性含义。我们证明这两个对象可以与非确定性计算的轻松共存。也就是说，我们给出的证据表明，当 $\mathsf{P} = \mathsf{NP}$ 时，可以存在量子性证明，并且当 $\mathsf{BQP} = \mathsf{QCMA}$ 时，（量子验证者）不经意的状态准备可以存在。特别是，我们给出了一个相对于它的经典预言 (1) $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{NP}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{PSPACE}^\mathcal{O}$ (3) 存在量子性证明。特别是， $\mathsf{IP}^\mathcal{O} \subseteq \mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O}$ 中存在一种语言，它平均很难对抗 $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O}/poly$。我们给出一个酉预言，使得 (1) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{QCMA}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) 存在量子验证者不经意的状态准备。这些预言机的分离直接意味着许多相关的后果。例如，我们的第一个结果意味着量子性证明不能用于通过相对化证明来构造经典或量子密码学。

我们的第二个结果意味着量子计算/经典通信不经意转移不能用于构造具有相对化证明的后量子单向函数。

title: Breaking the quantum barriers for Graph Collision
abstract: In the graph collision problem, the task is to decide whether a known graph on $n$ vertices contains an edge with both endpoints marked, given query access to the input bits specifying the marked vertices. We first refute the conjectured $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ query lower bound with a bounded error quantum algorithm using $\widetilde O(n^{92/139})$ queries. We then refine this approach to obtain a $\widetilde O(n^{11/17})$ query algorithm. We also obtain a $\widetilde O((nq)^{11/17})$ query bound for all (partial) Boolean output functions with positive certificate complexity at most 2 and alphabet size $q$, contrasting a known $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ lower bound for such problems with large alphabet sizes. We complement these algorithms with an $\Omega(\sqrt{n\log n})$ quantum query lower bound for graph collision, exceeding the $O(\sqrt n)$ certificate complexity barrier for the positive adversary method.
summary: 在图碰撞问题中，任务是在给定对指定标记顶点的输入位的查询访问的情况下，确定 $n$ 个顶点上的已知图是否包含两个端点均已标记的边。我们首先使用 $\widetilde O(n^{92/139})$ 查询通过有界误差量子算法反驳推测的 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ 查询下界。然后我们改进这种方法以获得 $\widetilde O(n^{11/17})$ 查询算法。我们还获得了所有（部分）布尔输出函数的 $\widetilde O((nq)^{11/17})$ 查询边界，其正证书复杂度最多为 2 且字母大小为 $q$，与已知的 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ 下限相比，此类问题具有较大的字母大小。我们用图碰撞的 $\Omega(\sqrt{n\log n})$ 量子查询下界来补充这些算法，超过了正对抗方法的 $O(\sqrt n)$ 证书复杂性障碍。
